about: Visual source of truth for every GenerateImage still. Hand-authored facts only: look, dress, demeanor, presence (how the frame treats them — skipped on a redress era), carry, fighting, horse, eras, never. Derived at build time (do NOT copy here): portrait by year + binyeo + object board from src/lib/people.ts, character hex from CHARACTER_COLORS/COLOR in people.ts, sword tagline + pommel from src/lib/swords.ts, place board from src/lib/places.ts. Costume: the "costume" kit attaches each Samhan kingdom's hanbok chart for every person of that kingdom (and for `dress:<kingdom>` extras), plus the kingdom crown for anyone holding a King/Queen title that year out of battle. Headwear: the "hats" kit (jougwan) is attached by default to men of Silla, Goguryeo, Baekje and Gaya out of armor and out of a crown; a character "hat" field ("jougwan" | false, or a year-ranged list) overrides it, and --no-hat / canon { hat: false } drops it for a scene. Kingdom flag ref is derived from KINGDOMS in people.ts (flag_*.svg → flag_*.png via scripts/rasterize-flags.mjs); only the in-world banner text lives here. Build with: node scripts/visual-canon.mjs --year <Y> [--battle|--sword|--mounted|--flags] <ids…> place:<id> flag:<kingdom>. Any field may be a list of { from?, until?, text | id } to change by year; an era with "redress": true replaces the portrait's clothing and the base look/dress (face only). A place "mood" is that place's default light and hour. Faces: every person in this chronicle has BLACK eyes and a Korean nose — see faces.common.

faces.common: KOREAN FACES on every person, named or extra: living eyes with WHITE sclera, a small catchlight, and BLACK ink-black iris and pupil (never brown, hazel, amber, honey, gold, blue, grey, green or purple). Never paint the entire eyeball solid black. A low soft Korean nasal bridge, never a high European, Roman or Persian nose. East Asian bone: single-lidded or low-creased eyes, straight or softly arched brows, broad cheekbones, flatter facial planes, warm ivory to sun-browned skin, straight coarse black hair. Never Western, Latin, or mixed-race features, never deep-set double-lidded western eyes.

armor.common: Battle armor: plates are METALLIC GRAY STEEL lamellar copied from the attached lamellar ref, cloth peeking at collar, sleeves, skirt, sash and plume-cord in the wearer's color only. Ignore labels and watermarks on armor refs. Not Japanese kabuto, not fantasy plate, not a gold-painted suit.

silla.text: Silla kit: steel lamellar cuirass and skirt, tall pointed jonghyeongju helm with a short plume.

baekje.text: Baekje kit: steel lamellar, rounded Baekje helm with neck guard; yellow cloth peeking, red sash/skirt accent — never a yellow metal cuirass.

goguryeo.text: Goguryeo kit: steel lamellar with red-edged plates and RED WING shoulder-flaps, peaked helm with plume — red cloth, never gold plate.

gaya.text: Gaya kit: steel lamellar, tall conical helm (고깔); purple cloth peek only — no purple cape dump.

tang.text: Tang kit: Tang lamellar with round polished chest-mirror plates (mingguang), wide shoulder guards — a different silhouette from Korean lamellar.

flags.common: Kingdom banners: copy field colour and emblem from the attached flag_*.png ref onto period silk war-banners — tall poles behind each side, long streamers, small pennants on spear-tips and saddle-backs. Painted silk, wind-whipped, torn and smoke-stained in battle; never a flat modern flag graphic. Each side's banner colour is the clearest colour on its half of the frame, so the kingdom reads at a glance.
flags.silla: Silla banners: blue silk with a white crescent moon.
flags.baekje: Baekje banners: warm yellow silk with a darker gold door-lintel and three gold stars.
flags.goguryeo: Goguryeo banners: red silk with the black three-legged crow inside a studded black sun-ring.
flags.tang: Tang banners: vermilion silk with a yellow sun disc and a dark brush glyph inside it — painted as an illegible brush mark, never readable text.
flags.yamato: Wa banners: red silk with a gold many-petalled sunburst.

horses.common: HORSE ANATOMY is a centrepiece: the whole horse body reads clearly and beautifully — arched neck, deep chest, sloping shoulder, round haunch, clean long legs in a correct gait, every muscle modelled by the one hard key with a bright edge along the topline and deep shadow under the belly; the horse is never cropped into a blob, never hidden behind dust, never stiff like a toy; mane and tail as flowing painted strokes; the coat colour exactly as the board.

costume.common: COSTUME CHARTS (attached): cut, collar, sleeve, sash, trouser and skirt shapes of every Samhan figure follow the chart for their kingdom; it is a style chart, so ignore its labels, captions, maps, poses and faces. Named people keep their portrait face and colours; extras and soldiers dress like the chart (a commoner like its commoners, an official like its officials, a soldier like its soldiers). COMMONERS in every Samhan kingdom wear SIMPLE WHITE: plain undyed white or off-white hemp and ramie jackets, wide trousers and skirts, a cloth sash, straw sandals or bare feet, hair in a plain topknot or braid — no dyed silk, no dots, no gold; colour belongs to rank, so a crowd of farmers, porters, servants and townsfolk reads as a field of soft white cloth with the officials' colours standing out of it.

silla.name: Silla
silla.crownText: Silla gold crown exactly as the attached museum photo (Cheonmachong / Hwangnamdaechong, 27 to 36 cm tall, as tall again as the face): an OPEN crown with no cap or lining, the hair and topknot showing through it. A NARROW flat gold headband (about a thumb wide) sits level on the forehead. Rising from it, THREE flat sheet-gold tree uprights, one at the centre front and one over each ear: each is a straight vertical stem whose short straight side-branches turn UP at right angles in three or four stacked tiers (like 出), every tip a small bud or heart. At the BACK, two shorter flat antler-shaped uprights angle outward with alternating branches, seen behind the tree uprights, never curling out like horns at the sides. Every upright and the band is hung on fine gold wires with hundreds of small round trembling gold spangles and many curved pale-green jade gogok. From the band at each temple, a long pendant chain of gold leaf-shapes falls past the cheek to the collarbone. Thin, bright, pale gold-silver sheet that trembles and catches light. NEVER a solid basket, never a castle battlement or fence, never horns or deer antlers curving at the sides, never a cap inside, never a European spiked crown or tiara.

baekje.name: Baekje
baekje.crownText: Baekje king, as the attached crown (ignore its studio backdrop and logo): a tall rounded black silk cap (오라관) with a plain black band at the brow, and a pair of tall openwork gold flame-and-leaf ornaments (금제관식) pinned to either side of the cap, rising above it like twin flames — thin gold blades fanning upward with leaf buds and curls; the king’s red robe and wide-sleeved layers as the Baekje king on the costume chart.

noble.text: Baekje great-clan lord’s gilt-bronze crown (금동관), as the attached crown (ignore its museum stand and black backdrop): a tall pointed gilt cap shaped like a peaked hood, pierced all over with openwork dragon-and-flame scrolls, a broad engraved band across the brow, a curved openwork crest arching over the top, two small cup-shaped finials on thin stems rising at the back, a pointed bud finial at the crown, and a flat openwork leaf-plume at the front. Worn high over the topknot on court and assembly days; burnished gold-bronze catching the key light. At court audiences and sacrifices a pair of thin GOLD WING ornaments is added, one rising from each side of the cap like swept bird wings; never in war. It replaces the jougwan.

gaya.name: Gaya
gaya.crownText: Gaya gold crown, as the attached crown: a gold band with tall upright grass-leaf finials and hanging jade gogok.

goguryeo.name: Goguryeo
goguryeo.crownText: Goguryeo gold crown, as the attached crown: a gold band crowded with upright flame and branch sprays hung with small round gold spangles; at court the king may instead wear the tall silk cap of the king on the costume chart.

buyeo.name: Buyeo
buyeo.note: Buyeo dresses like early Goguryeo in cut: the traditional left-closing jackets and trousers of the chart's first section. But Buyeo PREFERS WHITE: at home everyone, lords included, wears wide-sleeved robes and trousers of white cloth with leather shoes; only abroad or at feasts do great men add silk, brocade and embroidery, cloaks of fox, white monkey and black sable, and hats trimmed in gold and silver.

jolbon.name: Jolbon
jolbon.note: Jolbon is early Goguryeo: the traditional left-closing jackets, dotted fabrics and trousers of the chart's first section.

jougwan.name: Jougwan (조우관 鳥羽冠, feather cap)
jougwan.text: JOUGWAN (조우관, feather cap) — copy the SHAPE from the attached hat boards and ignore their Korean labels, museum photos, paper-craft gems and dragon medallion: a small black lacquered gauze cap (변형모, a peaked or square-topped crown no bigger than the topknot it covers) set high on the crown of the head over a small knot of gathered hair (any loose hair the portrait shows still falls beneath it); a thin black band round the head with a small square opening at the front; black cords tied under the chin; two long barred pheasant tail feathers (tan with umber bars), or a spray of bird plumes, rising straight up or sweeping back from either side of the cap, much taller than the cap itself. It replaces any other hat or cap on the portrait; headbands and ribbons stay. Real lacquer and feathers lit by the scene key, never a glow.
jougwan.hwarang: As a hwarang he keeps the crescent-moon headband across the brow, its tails trailing; the jougwan sits on the crown of the head above it.

yushin.look: Tall, broad-shouldered, long black hair in a high topknot-ponytail with trailing Silla-blue cloth tails; level hard brows. Unmistakably Korean face: BLACK eyes (never brown, blue or grey), a low soft Korean nasal bridge, never a high European nose.
yushin.dress: Silla-blue po and trousers, plum-violet sash knotted at the waist, white inner collar, dark wrapped forearms. Off duty: plain blue po, no jewelry.
yushin.demeanor: Confucian: he STANDS — never sits in lotus. Weighs, counts, frowns at sums; tight jaw, rare dry half-smile. Grief shows as stillness, not tears. The most feared warrior in all of Samhan: a line goes quiet when the tall Silla helm and the white horse appear. Massive, deliberate, terrifying at a walk; by Hwangsan (65) heavier and slower than Gyebek but still the man armies are built around.
yushin.carry: One fish-ring sword at the left hip. Never two blades.
yushin.fighting: Orthodox FORWARD one-hand grip, ring at the heel of the fist; square upright stance, short economical straight cuts and thrusts — the drill-yard form he teaches. Mounted, he cuts down from the saddle on the off side.

eras.text: Hwarang years (stage portrait): BEARDLESS, Silla-blue headband with a gold crescent moon, its tails trailing.
Marshal: full black beard and moustache; a blue ribbon in the topknot instead of the headband.
Old marshal: grey-streaked beard, heavier frame, slower — still stands, still counts.

never: sitting in lotus or holding prayer beads
katana, tsuba or curved blade (ignore the sword drawn on his portrait)

armorNote.text: Silla scale-and-lamellar armour with a rounded-pointed Silla helm and cheek-and-neck guards, topped by a SMALL THREE-PRONGED iron FORK finial (like the Yushin statue); Silla-blue #2A5FB8 cloth at the collar, sleeves, sash and plume-cord.

SUPREME GENERAL armour (Taedaegakgan), after the standard portrait, matte painted: gilt-bronze scale shoulder cape and gilt scale skirt panels edged in red and white bands, dark iron fish-scale cuirass with a white centre seam, Silla-blue #2A5FB8 sash under a black belt with a gilt sunburst buckle, teal roundel-patterned apron, salmon-red riveted arm guards. It combines every family helm: dark iron bowl with a gilt brow band carrying Seohyeon's SMALL HORNS, Yushin's THREE-PRONGED FORK finial on top, Muryuk's Gaya flared neck flange and red horsehair plume, red-lined mail hood.

gyebek.look: Lean and hard, sun-dark skin; black hair in a high topknot with loose strands over the brow; heavy scowl, narrow dark eyes, clean-shaven.

tamla.text: Tamla exile (attached /ch_gyebek_tamla.png): same hard face, long LOOSE black hair (no topknot, no cap, no jougwan), a short goatee and stubble; a full ORANGE Tamla robe with a white inner collar and a rust-red sash knotted at the waist. Island cloth, not Baekje court silk, not armor. FACE AND GARMENTS from that portrait.

training-early.text: Tamla training YEAR ONE. FACE ONLY from the attached head (same hard face, long LOOSE black hair, short goatee). BODY is NOT the training portrait: SKINNY lean exile, slight muscle, visible ribs, thin shoulders and thin arms, a soldier after a boat — not bulky, not a six-pack, not thick biceps. Orange wrap-skirt, rust-red sash, a plain wooden STAFF. No robe, no armor, no jougwan, no sword.

training-mid.text: Tamla training YEAR TWO–THREE. FACE ONLY from the attached head (same hard face, long LOOSE black hair, short goatee). BODY filling out: shoulders wider, real muscle starting, still lean, not the finished bodybuilder of the training portrait, not skinny-ribbed. Orange wrap-skirt, rust-red sash, a plain wooden STAFF. No robe, no armor, no jougwan, no sword.

training.text: Tamla training FIVE-YEAR body (attached /ch_gyebek_training.png): same hard face, long LOOSE black hair, short goatee; BARE CHEST, FULLY MUSCULAR frame, thick arms, carved abdomen, a TONED MUSCULAR BACK; orange wrap-skirt and rust-red sash, a plain wooden STAFF in one hand. No robe, no armor, no jougwan, no sword. FACE AND BODY from that portrait.

armour.text: General of Baekje in the field (attached /ch_gyebek_general.png): FACE from that portrait. Steel gray lamellar, rounded Baekje helm with a gold plume-socket and neck guard, crimson cloth peeking at sleeves, a red sash; ignore the curved blade on the portrait — if a sword is in frame it is the straight ring-pommel of sw_bidam, reverse grip.

gyebek.dress: Ochre-gold jeogori and trousers, a crimson scarf knotted at the chest, crimson sash at the waist, forearms wrapped in dark cloth.
gyebek.demeanor: Says little. Counts under his breath. Grim, tired, absolutely decided; never smiles in a fight. Rose from a nameless White River boy to 백승계백 (Hundred-Victories Gyebek); by Hwangsanbeol the taverns argue he is the stronger blade than Yushin, and one-to-one he is: twenty-five years younger, faster, never beaten in single combat. Rides low and coiled, like he fights.
gyebek.carry: One phoenix-ring sword, scabbard worn edge-up on the left hip.
gyebek.fighting: REVERSE GRIP (역수), like a Japanese warrior's backhand hold: the small RING pommel pokes out ABOVE his thumb, the blade exits BELOW his little finger and lies flat back along the outside of his forearm toward the elbow, edge facing out. Low coiled crouch, blade-arm held across his body like a shield; he draws and cuts in one rising backhand slash, then stabs downward. Mounted, the blade trails back along the horse's flank. The blade is still the STRAIGHT ring-pommel sword of sw_bidam (handle:blade 1:3) — reverse grip is the hold, not a different sword. This hold overrides the hanging-blade 'ring at the little-finger side' note in SWORD ANATOMY; the ring→band→grip→collar→blade order is unchanged. SIGNATURE MOVE (the general-killer): alone on Gomanari at a flat-out gallop, he comes out of nowhere across an empty field straight at the enemy general, body folded flat and aerodynamic along the horse’s neck, cheek almost on the mane, the reverse-gripped blade laid back along his forearm and the horse’s flank; on the pass he snaps one backhand draw-cut, swift and clean like a samurai iai cut, and is already past, the blade flicked out to the side, before the escort moves. Show speed through the long low line of horse and rider, streaming mane, flung mud, motion-blurred ground — never gore; the cut reads as a bright arc, a flying helm plume or a riderless horse. Stills of the move are manga action frames: speed lines, focus lines, extreme foreshortening, an impact flash at the cut.

eras.text: Boyhood (ch_gyebek_boy): a thin nameless river boy of about thirteen, barefoot, in a plain undyed WHITE hemp shirt and trousers with a rope belt; short-to-medium loose black hair, no topknot, no cap, no headband, no scarf, no armor; flat, watchful, unblinking eyes.

never: curved blade, katana or tsuba (ignore the sword drawn on his portrait)
forward textbook grip once the fight starts

yuridora.look: Sun-dark island king, forties; black hair in a small topknot, a short black beard and moustache, laughing mouth, heavy brows. FACE from attached /ch_yuri_dora.png.
yuridora.dress: Orange Tamla robe over a white inner collar, huge loose white sleeves, a white sash. Barefoot. No crown, no jougwan, no armor.
yuridora.demeanor: Unhurried, wry, starts at the beginning and will not be rushed. Points, laughs, pours. Never in a hurry.

gesomun.look: Massive, broad-chested; black hair in a tight topknot tied with red cord; thick black beard trimmed close to the jaw, heavy brows, glaring eyes.
gesomun.dress: Dark charcoal robe and trousers under red-edged armor, a red cape falling off the shoulders.
gesomun.demeanor: Arrogant, theatrical, loud; looks down at people (worm's-eye suits him). Laughs while fighting.

carry.text: ONE sword only before 642: the Eastern Crow Blade at the hip. The Northern, Southern and Western Crow Blades and the High Commander Blade still belong to the other four commanders.
FIVE crow-ring swords (身佩五刀): four crossed in a fan on his back with the hilts rising above his shoulders, plus one at the hip.

fighting.text: One crow-ring sword, forward one-hand grip, ring pommel at the heel of the fist. Wide aggressive stance, scything cuts, the free arm flung out. Straight sw_bidam anatomy, 1:3.

DUAL-WIELDS: a crow-ring sword in EACH hand, both forward one-hand grips, ring pommels at the heel of each fist. Wide aggressive stance, arms flung apart, scissoring cross-cuts and windmill slashes; lose one blade and he pulls another off his back. Each blade straight sw_bidam anatomy, 1:3.

never: beardless face (except a flashback to youth)

eras.text: Last years (ch_yeon_gesomun_old): iron-grey hair in a tight topknot tied with red cord, grey-streaked beard, heavier jowls, same glare; still in red-wing Goguryeo lamellar and a red cape.

yeonjayu.look: Bald crown with a white fringe at the temples, long white beard and heavy Yeon brows, the same hard jaw as Taejo and Gesomun; old, massive, still upright.
yeonjayu.dress: Goguryeo steel lamellar with red-edged plates and RED WING shoulder-flaps, a red cape, dark charcoal under-robe, one ring-pommel sword at the hip.
yeonjayu.demeanor: Silent first chair. Looks down the way Gesomun does, without the laugh.
yeonjayu.carry: ONE crow-ring sword at the hip. Never five on the back.
never: a full head of dark hair

yeontaejo.look: Gesomun's father and an old man in every still: snow-white hair in a tight topknot tied with dark red cord, long white beard and moustache, the same heavy straight Yeon brows and hard jaw as his sons, deep lines around tired, watchful eyes; shoulders once massive, now slightly stooped.
yeontaejo.dress: Retired High Commander's court dress, not armor: long charcoal-black silk robe crossed left over right with deep crimson #8f3a2e edging at collar, cuffs and hem, crimson sash, short dark fur-trimmed overcoat over the shoulders, black boots.
yeontaejo.demeanor: Quiet, unsmiling, economical; says half of what he thinks. Reads reports more than once. The only man Gesomun lowers his voice for.
yeontaejo.carry: A plain wooden walking staff in the right hand. He no longer wears a sword.
never: dark hair or a black beard

chunchu.look: Slim and elegant; shoulder-length loose black hair parted in the middle; amused eyes, small knowing smile. Unmistakably Korean face: BLACK eyes (never brown, blue or grey), a small straight Korean nose with a low bridge, smooth oval face.
chunchu.dress: Magenta-crimson silk po with a charcoal sash, dark layered collar. Silk even on campaign.

ambassador.text: Envoy dress (attached ch_chunchu_ambassador.png): plain white silk po with wide magenta-crimson bands at the collar, cuffs and sleeves, a black sash knotted at the front; the small grey jougwan with two barred pheasant feathers. Travel-clean, unarmored, no gold.

formal.text: Court dress (attached ch_chunchu_formal.png): crimson patterned silk po with a gold-brocade collar band down the front, a plain gold belt; purple silk cap ringed by the gilt Silla winged crown, and pinned upright at the front of the cap the Cheonmachong BUTTERFLY-SHAPED GOLD CAP ORNAMENT exactly as the attached photo (ignore its black backdrop): a thin sheet-gold ornament like a butterfly with two pairs of spread wings above a short tongue-shaped stem, pierced all over with tiny holes and hung with dozens of small round gold spangles on wire loops that shiver as he moves; long gold drop earrings. No jougwan.

chunchu.demeanor: Diplomat and strategist: talks with his hands, smiles while calculating, never shouts; half-lidded watchful eyes.
chunchu.carry: Imugi court sword at the hip, nearly always sheathed.
chunchu.fighting: Rarely draws. When he must: brave but clumsy, forward grip with the second hand steadying it; he fights with words first.

eras.text: Young hwarang (stage portrait): clean-shaven, no moustache, no goatee, a young man's face; eager.
Thin moustache and goatee stubble.
King Muyeol (stage portrait): royal robes and crown; heavier, tired eyes.

never: Never a Chinese-style hat: no futou, no winged samo, no brimmed black gat; out of battle he wears only the small black Silla jougwan feather cap or a bare topknot with a gold pin.
Never a large or high-bridged nose; never light-coloured eyes.

bidam.look: Tall, handsome, clean-shaven; KIN of Kim Chunchu — same Jinji-hall bone (Bidam is Jinji's nephew, Chunchu is Jinji's grandson): the same oval Korean face, same amused half-lid, same long brow; NOT a clone, not twins. Bidam is taller, warmer. BLACK eyes (never brown, hazel, blue or grey); a small straight Korean nose with a low bridge. Short slicked-back black hair as councillor; as hwarang the hair is longer, falling past the shoulders.
bidam.dress: Councillor: his signature hybrid coat — a long white outer robe whose wide sleeves are embroidered with galloping black horses, with deep navy #141C2E bands down the lapels and a navy yoke across the shoulders, over a plum-magenta inner robe and dark sash; the bead string looped on the right wrist. Navy lives only in those lapel and shoulder bands and on the beads — never a glow.

hwarang.text: Hwarang years (attached /ch_bidam_hwarang.png): long black hair under a small jougwan with two dark barred feathers; a PURPLE crescent-moon headband (white crescent) across the brow; a long purple po over a black inner robe and black sash. Same hall-face as young Chunchu in magenta — purple vs magenta is how you tell them apart. Beads on the right wrist. Keen, faintly amused, already counting the room.

bidam.demeanor: Buddhist: 108 beads wrapped on the wrist or rolling through his fingers, lotus seat, incense, a sutra under his breath; calm, ironic, never hurried. In anger the smile stays and the eyes go flat. At a board (go, ssangnyuk) he is the cleverest in the yard — three moves ahead, talking pleasantly while he wins; the same hall-intelligence Chunchu will show later in magenta.
bidam.carry: Heavenly-horse ring sword at the left hip; the bead string on the same right hand.
bidam.fighting: Flowing circular hwarang yard form, forward one-hand grip, the bead string looped around his sword wrist; patient — waits, then one clean cut. Never wild, never two blades.

eras.text: Young hwarang (stage portrait /ch_bidam_hwarang.png): long hair, purple po, purple crescent headband, jougwan; KIN-FACE with Chunchu as above. Beardless.
Councillor: short slicked hair, NO headband, white horse-sleeve coat over plum-magenta.
Older Sangdaedeung (stage portrait): grey at the temples, same smile, no headband.

never: headband after he leaves the yard (632 on)
cloning Chunchu's face or magenta coat — they are kin, not the same man

sunduk.look: Pale oval face, dark calm eyes; black hair in a full coiled updo; when crowned, the gold Silla tree-and-antler crown hung with jade gogok.
sunduk.dress: Crimson court robe with gold phoenix brocade, blue embroidered cape-collar, a red ribbon bow at the chest.
sunduk.demeanor: Composed, faint smile, wit in the eyes; looks up at the sky (Cheomseongdae). Never weepy, never cowed.

eras.text: Princess Deokman (stage portrait): no crown, hair pinned with her binyeo.

never: fantasy tiara in place of the Silla gold crown

jinduk.look: As Princess Sungman: a rounder, younger Sacred Bone face than Sunduk, warm dark eyes, a small worried mouth, black hair in a full coiled updo under the gold crescent binyeo. As queen: the same bones, a little thinner, still kind.
jinduk.dress: Salmon-peach Silla silk jeogori and chima, gold crescent binyeo (attached /ch_seungman.png as princess, /ch_jinduk.png as queen). In the steam cavern: that silk hiked, feet in the water, NO gold crown.
jinduk.demeanor: Gentle, brief, worries aloud. She held the seat and never pretended she ruled.

princess.text: Princess Sungman (attached /ch_seungman.png): younger, warmer, salmon-peach silk, gold crescent binyeo, no crown. FACE AND GARMENTS from that princess portrait.

never: a gold tree-and-antler crown in the cavern
a lecture about being a bridge

chunmyung.look: Late forties at her death: a long oval Korean face, dry unhurried eyes, silver-grey in the black hair, a full coiled updo under the gold amethyst binyeo. Young: the same bones, all black hair, sharper mouth (attached /ch_chunmyung_young.png).
chunmyung.dress: Lavender-purple Silla silk jeogori and chima (attached /ch_chunmyung.png). A wax tablet tucked in the sleeve. In the cavern: that silk, feet in the water, NO crown.
chunmyung.demeanor: Dry. She does not ask how you are. She sits very straight. She was already here.

munmu.look: Square jaw, goatee and moustache, confident grin; arms folded when he is pleased with himself.
munmu.dress: As king: crimson robe with gold dragon embroidery, blue shoulder pieces, gold Silla crown. Earlier: prince/hwarang stage portraits.
munmu.demeanor: Cocky, warm, practical; his father's charm with his uncle's spine.
munmu.fighting: Forward grip, aggressive cavalry officer — charges first, cuts from the saddle.
never: Tang dragon robe in place of Silla court dress

kingmu.look: Baekje king: long Korean face, a smiling mustache, a short pointed beard, heavy brows, a gleeful half-smile. In 602 he is forty-one: dark hair in a high topknot, dark mustache, almost no grey — the attached /ch_mu.png is older; keep the same face bones and the same smile, drop the grey.
kingmu.dress: Crimson-red Baekje court robe with a cream inner collar and dark sash (attached /ch_mu.png). Face only in battle — do not wear the red robe under armor.
kingmu.demeanor: Gruff and gleeful. Points at a gate like a game he means to win. Rides at the front.
never: the grey-bearded old portrait body in 602

euija.look: Broad, bearded king; black hair in a topknot with a yellow-gold headband whose tails trail; heavy brows, cynical eyes.
euija.dress: Crimson robe with a dark charcoal collar and gold trim; a steel lamellar pauldron peeking at one shoulder.
euija.crownNote: On Euija the two side ornaments are King Muryeong's gold diadem ornaments exactly as the attached museum photo (ignore its backdrop): a pair of thin sheet-gold flame-and-honeysuckle sprays, each a central stem with curling leaf-flames fanning up and out, pierced openwork and hung with small round gold spangles, one pinned on each side of the black silk cap and rising well above it.

disguise.text: DISGUISE: the same face, beard and yellow-gold headband as the attached portrait, but dressed only in a plain undyed GREY hemp robe with a deep GREY hood pulled up over the topknot, a rope belt, straw sandals. No crimson, no gold trim, no armor, no jewelry. A prince badly pretending to be nobody.

eras.text: PRISONER IN THE TANG CAPITAL: broad bearded old king, heavy brows, cynical eyes. One plain undyed WHITE hemp robe and nothing else — no headband, no topknot, no crown, no gold, no crimson, no armor, no belt ornament, barefoot; his long black hair streaked grey hangs LOOSE and unbound past his shoulders; beard unkempt.

euija.demeanor: Licensed wit: drinks, smirks, slumps on the throne, speaks in polished aphorisms. Fatalist.
euija.fighting: Tiger-ring sword is ceremonial; he barely draws it.

kangrim.look: Face hidden under a wide black gat brim — only mouth and jaw visible; tall and thin.
kangrim.dress: Black reaper's robe over blue and vermilion layers, white gat strings.
kangrim.demeanor: Silent, unhurried, reads names from the red register.
kangrim.fighting: Draws only a hand's width of black iron; the reaper cuts once — a cord, not flesh.
kangrim.style: Keep his portrait's ink-brush dissolve at his edges.

bangul.look: Boy of fifteen at the Yellow Mountain: square Korean face, a bright reckless half-grin, red liner at the outer eye, long black hair; crimson crescent-moon headband with long red tails.
bangul.dress: White hwarang po over a sky-blue inner collar, crimson sash tails, dark under-sleeves, small jougwan with two tan pheasant feathers (attached /ch_bangul.png).
bangul.demeanor: Young, brave, and in a hurry. Rides first.

gwanchang.look: Boy of fifteen at the Yellow Mountain: smooth face, bright eyes with a red liner wing, long black hair in a topknot with side locks; Silla-blue headband with a crescent-moon emblem.
gwanchang.dress: White hwarang po with crimson collar and crimson sash, dark under-sleeves, wrapped forearms.
gwanchang.demeanor: Eager, smiling, reckless courage — a boy, not a man. Released once. Rides back.
gwanchang.fighting: A boy's grip on a man's edge: two hands on a one-hand colt-ring sword, overreaching lunges, all heart.

pumil.demeanor: Silla general and Gwanchang's father; holds rank over grief in public, breaks in private.
never: breaking down in front of the ranks

alchun.look: Broader, rounder face than Bidam or Yushin; warm half-smile, a red liner wing at the outer eye; as a boy no scar and no grey. Adult: grey tied back under a dark headband, a red scar cutting the left temple, thin goatee. Unmistakably Korean: BLACK eyes (never brown, blue or grey), a low soft Korean nasal bridge.
alchun.dress: Teal-green po. Hwarang: teal po over a crimson collar and crimson sash, teal crescent-moon headband, jougwan with two tan pheasant feathers. Councillor: teal po over a rust-red inner robe, dark sash, no jougwan. High Councillor: white dragon-embroidered overcoat over magenta, teal headband.
alchun.demeanor: Stuck between Bidam and Yushin since the yard. Blunt, folksy, eats in a line; the one who stands in the middle and grins. Tiger-catcher. Loyal to the throne over factions.

eras.text: Boy hwarang, FIFTEEN: leaner than Yushin and Bidam, frightened until he isn't; rounder face, no grey, no scar, teal over crimson. BODY matches the attached /ch_alchun_hwarang.png: normal teenage Korean proportions, broad shoulders under the teal sleeves, arms the right length. NOT noodle-thin, NOT extra-long arms, NOT a stick figure.
Young adult hwarang (stage portrait /ch_alchun_hwarang.png): no grey, no scar, teal and crimson, crescent headband, jougwan; taller now, the tiger-catcher of the yard.
Councillor (stage portrait /ch_alchun.png): grey coming, temple scar, teal over rust-red.
High Councillor (stage portrait /ch_alchun_council.png): white dragon coat over magenta.

jewelry.text: Silla gold: thick-ring gold earrings hung with chains of tiny gold leaves and spangles that tremble when she turns her head; a necklace of gold beads and blue glass beads with one green jade comma (gogok) at the centre; a thin gold bracelet.

munhee.demeanor: Yushin's younger sister, Chunchu's wife; quick and warm, the one who bought the dream.
never: fantasy tiara instead of her binyeo

jumong.look: Lean archer; black hair half-bound under a knotted red headband with long tails; dark warm eyes, easy grin. CLEAN-SHAVEN before he is king — ignore the moustache and chin hair on his portrait.
jumong.dress: Red silk jeogori and po over a charcoal underlayer, rope-tied sash, wrapped forearms; bow across his back.
jumong.demeanor: Fun: grins, laughs, winks, easy eyes when Sosuno is mean; scared and a little stupid when it matters. Turns serious only for the bow — and for a descendant who will not take the house.
jumong.carry: Bow always (his object board); crow bow-knife at the belt.
jumong.fighting: Archer first: full draw, spare arrows held in the bow hand, shoots from the saddle at a gallop; the knife only at arm's length.

eras.text: King Dongmyeong: use the attached king portrait; beard allowed now.

never: facial hair before he is king

sosuno.look: Long straight black hair with a high topknot pinned by her gold binyeo, a thin red headband with a center jewel; sharp brows, cool appraising eyes.
sosuno.dress: Dusty-rose hanbok over white sleeves, black wrap sash with red cords, red-wrapped wrists; bow and quiver on her back. Her hex is lamplight or a ground stamp — never gold robes.
sosuno.demeanor: Sharp, quick, too much, then covering; a merchant's appraising glance.
sosuno.fighting: Archer with a short blade; shoots, does not duel.

haemosu.demeanor: Feral, greedy, easy sun-god — wants first. Divine render: photoreal-leaning and numinous beside painterly mortals.
haemosu.props: His chariot and fox match their object boards (/obj_haemosu_chariot.png, /obj_haemosu_fox.png).
never: colored glow outline around his body
cloned onto Haewonmek (Haewonmek is the shorter-haired fallen sun)

yuhwa.demeanor: Youngest river daughter; stays when her sisters dive; flirts, hedges, then dares.
never: fantasy tiara instead of her binyeo

hyukgose.demeanor: Demigod founder of Silla, hatched from the great egg at Najeong; photoreal and numinous beside painterly mortals.

boy.text: Egg-child / thirteen at crowning (attached /ch_hyukgose_young.png): a boy’s face, white po, blue collar and sash, small topknot, no beard. Photoreal-numinous still, never anime-flat.

old.text: Last years (attached /ch_hyukgose_old.png): white beard, blue silk, arms that have finished ruling.

alyoung.demeanor: Demigod queen born of the gyeryong at Alyeong well; photoreal and numinous. The beak-lip appears only in her birth beat at the Bukcheon stream.

onjo.demeanor: Younger brother, steadier; listens to the ten ministers and stays inland at Wirye. The Sinrok deer stays with him.

biryu.demeanor: Elder brother, sea-hungry and proud; wants the coast at Michuhol and will not listen.

taizong.look: Bearded Tang emperor: black futou cap with an upright pin, thick black beard and moustache, fierce scowl.
taizong.dress: Imperial yellow robe-cape over black brocade.
taizong.demeanor: Commands; never asks. Conqueror's contempt that curdles at Ansi.
taizong.presence: THE SON OF HEAVEN — every frame he is in bends around him. He is SHROUDED IN DARKNESS: the black of the hall gathers around him like a mantle. One close practical light (a lamp, a brazier, a lamp-tree) rakes across him from below or from the side and SCULPTS him — the heavy yellow silk breaks into deep protruding folds brushed in loaded oil strokes that follow each fold, gold thread flicked in with impasto, the beard and cheekbones carved — and then falls off into black across his body and half his face; that falloff is the darkness, never a flat backlit silhouette. The camera sits BELOW his eyeline (low angle or worm’s-eye) and he is always placed HIGHER than anyone near him — on the dais, on a step, standing while others kneel or sit. He reads larger than life through lens and staging, not as a giant: broad shoulders, the robe spreading wide and heavy into the dark like a mountain, his shadow enormous on walls and floor. Unhurried, heavy stillness — never fidgeting, never casual, never a colleague at someone’s shoulder; when he smiles or laughs it is a predator’s ease, and the room goes quiet around it. Everyone else in frame is smaller, lower, less lit, turned toward him. The aura is darkness, scale and the hush around him — never a glow, never a halo, never rays behind his head.

eras.text: LI SHIMIN, PRINCE OF QIN, early twenties: the same face as the portrait but young and lean, a short black moustache and a short curled beard, hair bound in a plain topknot under a small black cap or a Tang helm — no emperor's yellow robe, no imperial cape. On campaign: Tang lamellar with round chest-mirror plates, a red war-robe under it, a great horn bow and a quiver of long white-fletched arrows at the saddle; he rides ahead of his own men.

taizong.fighting: A straight double-edged Tang jian with a gold guard — the one blade in the chronicle that is NOT a ring-pommel sword. He leads mounted; he does not duel.

xuerengui.demeanor: Tang's white-robed champion; showman of the charge.
xuerengui.carry: Fangtian ji halberd — no ring sword at all.
xuerengui.fighting: Long-reach halberd sweeps from horseback at the head of a white-coated charge.

yangmanchun.demeanor: The nameless Ansi castellan: plain, unhurried, unbreakable; the fortress is his signature.
yangmanchun.fighting: On the wall with a bow; a crestless ring sword worn smooth.
never: crest or banner with his name

namseng.look: Gesomun's eldest: a tight high bun, TWO short loose strands at the temples, a neat goatee and thin moustache, a rigid square jaw, no long hair. Never Namgun's shoulder-length hair. Never Namsan's helm.
namseng.dress: Goguryeo steel lamellar with a RED scarf knot at the throat and a red sash; one crow-ring sword. In 666–668, when he rides west: a TANG vermilion court coat over steel, no red-wing flaps, no Goguryeo scarf.
namseng.demeanor: Gesomun's eldest; heir who kneels west in 666. Formal, correct, one word of venom.
namseng.fighting: His father's forward grip with one crow sword — never his father's two.
never: long loose hair past the shoulders

namgun.look: Gesomun's second: LONG loose black hair past the shoulders, a fuller beard covering the jaw, wilder heavier brows than Namseng, a bow-case on his back. Never Namseng's short temple-strands. Never Namsan's helm.
namgun.dress: Goguryeo steel lamellar with red laces, a gold square belt-plate, a red wrap at the hip, one crow-ring sword and a strung bow.
namgun.demeanor: Loud, loyal, easily aimed; the last shout on the wall.
namgun.fighting: One crow-ring sword, forward grip; a bow when the wall needs it. Never two swords. Never five on the back.
never: Namseng's short bun with temple strands

namsan.look: Gesomun's youngest: a rounder shorter face, a small goatee, eyes that look aside or down. Out of battle: a plain topknot, no helm. On the wall and in the field: a black rounded helm with a RED horsehair plume and a gold disc on the brow (his portrait helm).
namsan.dress: Goguryeo steel lamellar, a red cloak tied at the throat, a red sash; a polearm or one crow-ring sword. He is the one who walks out with the white banner.
namsan.demeanor: Quiet junior; alignment as weather. Looks at the ground when the brothers shout.
namsan.fighting: One weapon, never his father's two. Never five swords on the back.
never: a Tang coat until he surrenders

seohyeon.demeanor: Yushin's father; Gaya blood, Silla duty, quiet.
seohyeon.look: Gentle long face, apologetic eyes, a careful mouth; a softer cousin of young Yushin's face, never the same man. Completely clean-shaven and long-haired when young (loose topknot, long strands past the jaw); a thin moustache and short beard from his forties.

eras.text: A boy (Surabol lanes, the Gaya house): plain white child hanbok, hair in a boy's braid or small topknot, no cap.
Young official in his twenties, CLEAN-SHAVEN, no beard or moustache: steel-blue silk po, white collar, dark sash, jougwan cap over a loose topknot with long loose strands.
Grey-templed provincial governor and general; Silla steel lamellar on campaign.

armorNote.text: Silla steel lamellar with a pointed Silla helm whose brow band carries a pair of SMALL curved iron HORNS rising at the temples (short, like the horned brow of Yushin's standard portrait, not Viking horns); sky-blue #3E8EF0 cloth at the collar, sash and plume-cord.

muryuk.demeanor: Gaya prince turned Silla general; the egg-and-iron line.
muryuk.look: Square weathered Gaya face, heavy brows, long pauses in the eyes; grows grey, then white, but never bald under the helm.
muryuk.dress: Out of battle: plain dark Gaya-cut po with a purple sash; his Gaya helm (rounded iron bowl, wide flared brim, tall red horsehair cone) on his head or under his arm, ALWAYS, even indoors at home (it sits on a stand by the door at night).

eras.text: Gumgwan boy-prince: child or teen, the cone helm too big for him, coming down over his eyes.

Clean-shaven at seventeen (the ford, the pines, the cart), lean and scowling in a cone helm a little too big; a short beard from his late twenties. Silla general in the Gaya cone helm, steel lamellar on campaign.
Greying, then grey-bearded; the cone helm still on.
Very old: white beard, a stick, four blankets, the helm still on.

never: a Silla pointed helm in place of his Gaya helm

armorNote.text: Original Gaya kit: his GAYA HELM: a rounded dark-iron bowl of riveted strips with a wide flared iron brim-and-neck flange all round, crowned by a tall cone of red horsehair; red leather cords knotted under the chin; a coat of small dark iron scales laced with red-brown leather so densely it reads as CHAIN MAIL, mail cape over the shoulders, mail sleeves and leggings; purple #8B5CF6 sash and cuffs.

Silla general's kit that keeps the Gaya bones: Silla steel lamellar cuirass and skirt, but STILL his GAYA HELM: a rounded dark-iron bowl of riveted strips with a wide flared iron brim-and-neck flange all round, crowned by a tall cone of red horsehair; red leather cords knotted under the chin, plus a Gaya laced-mail aventail, mail cape and mail sleeves under the Silla plates; purple #8B5CF6 sash, cuffs and plume-cord.

sadaham.demeanor: Hwarang taken Gaya at fifteen; ice-blue #6fa8ff cloth on campaign; dies young of grief.
sadaham.look: Young hwarang: long black hair, defined jaw, ice-blue po, magenta sash, crescent headband. Same age as the river-stone and roof stills — a young man, not a child.

mugwan.look: Young hwarang: long black hair, quieter defined face, cream po with a dusty-rose collar and sash, crescent headband. Same age as Sadaham in the river-stone stills — a young man, not a child.

narim.demeanor: Eldest cavern goddess (leaves / earth-wood): elder-failing and breathless when a Kim looks at her kindly.
never: body glow aura (glowing eyes only on oracle pronouncements)

golhwa.demeanor: Fire cavern goddess: legs spread wide by default — sitting, riding the rock, lounging; chima hiked to the hips on wet stone; open pleasure face.
golhwa.element: Heat shimmer, embers, steam off skin.

hyulle.demeanor: Water cavern goddess: knees pressed tight together, gaze down or aside — shy, soaked, wrecked, the strongest want under silence.
hyulle.element: Drip, spray, soaked silk, water-light in the pool.

talhae.look: Young: tanned, one black eyepatch over the right eye, a shameless grin, black hair in a high topknot with a long tail. Not photoreal.
talhae.dress: Cream po over a blue inner, blue sash flying, maroon undersleeves, grey stone-texture shoulder pads, blue trousers, black boots; a short knife in the right fist (attached /ch_talhae.png).

king.text: King (attached /ch_talhae_king.png): same face, one black eyepatch over the right eye, a short black goatee, hair tied low; a purple po over a magenta inner robe, white collar, gold-patterned cream front panels, a simple open gold Silla crown (three 出 tree uprights). FACE AND GARMENTS from that portrait. Never two good eyes. Never the young running cream-and-blue kit.

talhae.demeanor: A con man who became a king and never stopped enjoying the joke. Deadpan when caught, delighted when he wins.
never: sea-green king robe (the king portrait is purple and magenta)

hogong.look: Small, wiry old man from Wa, bald crown with a grey fringe tied back, thin white beard, quick indignant eyes (attached /ch_hogong.png).
hogong.dress: Faded indigo minister’s robe; a dried calabash gourd always tied at his waist on a cord.
hogong.demeanor: Perpetually outraged and perpetually loyal; the straight man to Talhae’s joke for forty years.

aejin.look: Old Korean fisherwoman, weathered sun-brown face, sharp dry eyes, grey-streaked black hair in a low bun, a few loose strands (attached /ch_aejin.png).
aejin.dress: Undyed white hemp jeogori and chima, frayed cuffs, a rope coil or fish-basket; commoner white, no silk, no jewelry, no crown.
aejin.demeanor: Dry and practical; talks to a boy the way she talks to a catch she has not yet decided to keep.

namhae.look: Mild shaman-king in his forties: oval face, a short neat goatee, black hair in a low tie, worried kind eyes (attached /ch_namhae.png).
namhae.dress: Deep plum-burgundy court po over a white inner, gold-trimmed black collar band, a simple open gold Silla crown (three 出 tree uprights). FACE AND GARMENTS from that portrait.
namhae.demeanor: Reads an omen in every bird; shrewd once he stops fretting.

yuri_isageum.look: Young, gentle, a little shy: rounder face than his father, clean-shaven, straight black hair, honest dark eyes (attached /ch_nuri.png).
yuri_isageum.dress: Deep burgundy court po over a white inner, gold-trimmed black collar band, a simple open gold Silla crown (three 出 tree uprights). FACE AND GARMENTS from that portrait.
yuri_isageum.demeanor: Yields first, laughs at himself, sees more than he lets on.
never: Jumong’s son Yuri — this is Nuri of Silla, a different man

alji.look: A small boy of about four, round solemn face, bright wide-awake black eyes, short black hair tied in a tiny tuft.
alji.dress: Wrapped in a little white silk cloth with a thin gold thread edge.
alji.demeanor: Unafraid; looks at kings as if they were the strange ones.

manmyung.look: Young royal Kim noblewoman whose face runs in the family: mostly her granddaughter Gotaso's (oval face, bright almond eyes, small nose, cheerful sly mouth) with a touch of her daughter Munhee's long jaw and arched brows; one eyebrow up, a closed-mouth smirk. Black hair in a high round bun with loose strands at the temples, one gold binyeo with a red bead, small gold hoop earrings.
manmyung.dress: Short white silk jeogori with deep crimson collar ribbon and cuffs, long deep-crimson chima with a gold-embroidered waistband, a pale celadon-green shawl; good silk she will ruin in the rain.
manmyung.demeanor: Teasing, decisive, braver than the men around her; she makes the decisions and lets Seohyun think he did.

saimei.look: Empress past sixty with an ageless powdered face: red lips, a small vermilion mark on the brow, long grey hair falling loose past the shoulders; a white silk head-wrap with hanging braided cords under a small gold openwork crown.
saimei.dress: Layered white silk court robe with wide celadon-green borders patterned in pale-gold cloud scrolls; a long vermilion tasselled cord at the waist; the white train spreads on the floor around her.
saimei.demeanor: Old, immovable and sea-facing: she orders the fleet and does not argue it.

tenji.look: Lean prince in his thirties: high black topknot under a small black lacquered upright cap, sharp sideways glance, thin moustache and a pointed black goatee.
tenji.dress: Wide-sleeved slate-navy court robe brocaded with faded gold peony scrolls over cream under-layers; a flat wooden shaku tablet in one hand.
tenji.demeanor: Cold calculation: watches the western fires and keeps his own hands clean.
never: samurai armor of a later century

abe.look: Huge bearded seafarer-general: wild black hair in a rough topknot, full black beard, heavy brows, eyes narrowed against wind.
abe.dress: Grey wolf-fur mantle over a long red cape; a blue-grey quilted coat printed with pale leaf patterns, maroon edges and fur-trimmed cuffs; red cord sash.
abe.demeanor: Admiral of the cold northern seas: loud, physical, laughs into the wind.
never: samurai armor of a later century

gildal.look: Lean young clerk with a fox mask pushed up on the brow; black hair in a wild topknot, a knowing half-smile, fox-blood streaks painted down the cheeks.
gildal.dress: Orange-red wide robe over a magenta inner wrap, white bound forearms, a fox mask riding on the head like a cap.
gildal.demeanor: Punctual, courteous, faintly too good at paperwork.

song.text: SONG / GOBLIN: a fox-headed dokebi in the same orange robe, a tree-stump mallet over one shoulder, spirit-smoke around the feet; glowing fox eyes. This is the record’s fox, not the clerk.

gwija_elder.look: One-eyed old man, white beard to the chest, the empty socket under a black patch; a spotted cream robe whose hem roots into the ground like a tree.
gwija_elder.dress: Cream robe blotched rust-brown, a plain staff, bare weathered hands.

song.text: SONG / TREE SPIRIT: a wood-grain head with one hollow knot-eye, a cloud-halo, an orange-brown robe whose hem is a tangle of roots. No human face.

gwija_mother.look: Young mother, round solemn face, black hair piled with cloth knots and grey river-stones; a baby on her back in orange jeogori.
gwija_mother.dress: White jeogori, peach chima, teal sash, a long red ribbon, a collar of grey stones.
gwija_mother.demeanor: Flat and tired until her children come up, then sharp.

song.text: SONG / ROCK LADY: the same piled stones and baby, but a grey stone mask for a face and stone-grey hands; a cloud-halo. Not a human woman.

gwija_redmask.look: Three small boys in brown and cream hemp, masks hanging from their necks (purple, white, red), running as a knot; the smallest is the red-mask boy.
gwija_redmask.dress: Plain hemp jeogori and trousers, cloth sashes, hanging dokebi masks.
gwija_redmask.demeanor: Twelve and furious. The other two laugh; he does not.

song.text: SONG / RASCAL GOBLINS: the same three boys with the masks ON — purple, white, red — smoke and fire boiling out of the heads. No human faces.

guhae.look: Last king of Golden Gaya: broad Gaya face, dark beard, gold Gaya crown, purple and gold court silk.
guhae.dress: Gaya royal silk, gold belt, the Gaya crown (tall gilt openwork).
guhae.demeanor: Warm and theatrical with his sons; on his knees he bargains plainly.

eras.text: SURABOL COUNCILLOR (ch_guhae_councillor): older, grey hair and a long grey-blue beard, seated in a white Silla councillor’s robe with maroon-and-gold borders, a bead necklace, gold earrings; no Gaya crown.

takutsu.look: Young Yamato captain, clean-shaven, smooth webtoon face with straight brows and steady dark eyes; black hair pulled into a high round topknot, loose strands at the cheeks, a white cloth headband tied across the brow with long trailing tails.
takutsu.dress: Orange-red wide-sleeved robe with an ochre-gold collar, under a black-lacquered iron cuirass and square black shoulder flaps tied with gold cords; a broad white sash knotted at the hip with long hanging ends; full white trousers gathered above white bound shoes; a straight Yamato sword in a red-lacquered scabbard with gold fittings at the hip.
takutsu.demeanor: Calm, plain-spoken and unbending: the only captain who reads the tide, and the one who stays on the burning deck.
never: samurai armor of a later century

liurengui.look: Tang general of sixty-two: lean and upright, long narrow face, deep-set patient eyes, long grey moustache and a long thin grey beard to the chest, grey hair under a black Tang futou cap (or a Tang helm in battle).
liurengui.dress: Tang general's round-collared robe in dark slate-green over Tang mingguang armour: two round polished chest discs, lamellar skirt, shoulder guards; a vermilion cloak; a long brush-and-tablet case at the belt. Tang palette: vermilion, black, steel.
liurengui.demeanor: The Black Tortoise: patient, dry, unhurried; holds a line, never chases; watches an enemy the way a scholar reads a new script.

yung.look: Prince of Baekje in his late forties: broad calm face, high black topknot, thin moustache and small chin beard, heavy-lidded eyes that give nothing away.
yung.dress: Baekje prince's red robe with black outer sleeves and gold cloud-scroll collar and shoulders, red cord sash with long tassels.
yung.demeanor: Short and cold, then suddenly too quiet. The son who knelt.

eras.text: In Tang service: same face (high topknot, thin moustache, small chin beard); a Tang officer's round-collared robe (panling) in deep crimson with a black leather belt, black futou cap tied at the back over the topknot, black boots. No Baekje gold scrollwork, no jougwan. He looks like a Tang officer who was born somewhere else.

pung.look: Prince years: smooth beardless face, soft eyes, black hair in a topknot bound with a red-and-gold cord and a gold pin.
pung.dress: Red robe with black sleeves striped in gold, gold-brocade crossed collar, braided red-and-gold cord sash.

eras.text: King Pungjang (stage portrait): sharper face, a small chin goatee, loose strands falling from the topknot; red king's robe with dark-navy-lined sleeves, gold-scroll shoulders and a long gold cord sash.

pung.demeanor: Formal, slightly foreign-accented royal speech, brittle when contradicted; raised in Yamato, crowned by the general he beheaded.

sangji.look: Hard-faced Baekje general: black moustache and short square beard, heavy brows, a glare under a black helm with a tall red plume.
sangji.dress: Black-lacquered lamellar armour with square shoulder guards over a maroon-red robe, a tan cross-strap and wide tan belt; a long spear with a gilt head over the shoulder; a ring-pommel sword at the hip.
sangji.demeanor: A builder of walls who knows exactly where they are weak.

gulgul.look: Mohe-born, lean and weathered; dark skin, hard narrow eyes, thin moustache and a short chin beard as a man.
gulgul.dress: Goguryeo border warden: grey steel lamellar under a heavy white-grey fur mantle, dark-red sash and wrapped forearms.
gulgul.demeanor: Grim and spare. Says little, watches the door, stands one step behind whoever he serves.

eras.text: Boy (stage portrait ch_dae_gulgul_young): BEARDLESS, shaved crown with one dark centre strip, two long braids, blood-streaked defiant face, ragged fur over a white wrap.
The flight north: no helm, a fur hood and layered pelts over the lamellar, frost in the beard, a leather pack on his back.

daejoyoung.look: A boy in 668: round face, dark eyes under heavy brows, a soot or frost smudge on one cheek.
daejoyoung.dress: Red headband with a black sun-disc, brown fur collar, pale blue padded coat, red sash, tan trousers, wrapped leggings, a walking staff.
daejoyoung.demeanor: Restless and stubborn; complains, asks too many questions, then sets his jaw.

sateksangya.look: Stocky harbour lord about forty: sea-tanned skin, shrewd narrow pricing eyes, flat unimpressed mouth, clipped black beard and moustache, thick neck.
sateksangya.dress: Deep red wide-sleeved Satek robe with a black crossed collar under a plain grey steel lamellar vest; a dark sash with a string of square-holed bronze coins and bamboo tally slips at the hip; a rolled harbour ledger in hand.
sateksangya.demeanor: Wharf-flat: counts boats, bales and debts out loud.

munduk.look: Lean, weathered Goguryeo general: narrow watchful eyes, thin moustache and small chin beard, calm unreadable face of a man counting the enemy.
munduk.dress: Steel lamellar with a round bronze boss on the chest, a red scarf wound at the throat, red cloth sleeves and skirt; red-winged steel helm with a red plume.
munduk.demeanor: The Defender: patient, sly, unhurried — retreats on purpose, writes the enemy a poem, then springs the river.
munduk.fighting: Commands from the saddle with a long spear; a ring sword at the hip, rarely drawn.

boksin.look: Shaven-headed Baekje general: bald crown with one long black topknot tail tied in red cord and streaming behind, heavy scowling brows, black moustache and pointed black beard.
boksin.dress: Black-lacquered lamellar with heavy rounded shoulder guards and bracers over a slate-blue wrapped robe, a grey-mauve sash knotted at the waist; a long red-lacquered shaft carried low in one fist.
boksin.demeanor: Blunt and managerial, lethal when polite: the man who keeps the tally board.

dochim.look: Shaven-headed monk-general in his forties: calm narrow eyes, faint smile, a small dark goatee.
dochim.dress: Ochre-gold monk robe under a red-orange kasaya fastened at the left shoulder with an iron ring; a long string of black 108 beads looped over one hand; a gilt monk staff with a ringed finial over the shoulder.
dochim.demeanor: Soft voice, hard timetable: a sutra and a march order in the same breath.

yunchung.look: Hard-bitten Baekje frontier general in his forties: full black beard, heavy scowling brows, a band of red war-paint smeared across both eyes, long black hair falling from under a dented round steel helm with a cracked crown and a short red-black plume knob.
yunchung.dress: Grey steel lamellar with red-edged shoulder guards over an ochre-yellow robe, a broad red sash with a round bronze boss, red-and-black striped bracers; a ring-pommel sword in a red-lacquered scabbard.
yunchung.demeanor: Plain speech is also a weapon: says the ugly thing without a cushion under it, and does exactly what he says he will.

yeonwife.look: Composed Goguryeo noblewoman in her thirties: black hair braided and coiled up with a cluster of red silk flowers at the crown, loose strands at the cheeks, calm narrow eyes, small red mouth.
yeonwife.dress: Cut after the tomb owner's wife in the Ssangyeongchong mural: a long wide-sleeved jacket to the hip, crossed left over right and belted, in cream-buff silk with a broad rust-red band (襈) at the collar, cuffs and hem, over a long full skirt to the floor; a rust-red shawl over the arms, a long black sash.

jewelry.text: Goguryeo gold earrings: a thick hollow gold ring at each lobe with a short chain and a single heart-shaped gold leaf; no necklace, no bracelets.

yeonwife.demeanor: Quiet and precise; saves the hard questions for when the lamps are low.

court.text: Out of armour, dressed after the noblewoman of the Susan-ri mural: hair gathered up into a tall looped topknot, a small red rouge dot on each cheek, a long jacket to the hip with dark contrasting bands at collar, cuffs and hem, belted at the waist, over a long finely PLEATED skirt striped in bands of red, white, ochre and green that swings when she walks; soft cloth shoes. Gold earrings like Yeon's wife's.

sooyoung.demeanor: Practical tenderness; corrects cruelty more than posture. Stands like a soldier even in silk.

jewelry.text: The Baekje queen's gold from King Muryeong's tomb: long chain earrings, each a small gold ring with a cluster of tiny leaf spangles and a long chain of gold links ending in a heart-shaped leaf; a necklace of nine and seven jointed gold segments; one gold hairpin with a spread-wing top in the coiled hair.

ungo.demeanor: Quiet where Queen Satek was faction; moves a court without a clan crest.

wuzetian.look: Hair piled into a tall looped Tang chignon fixed with gold combs and flower pins, painted crescent brows, a red flower mark (huadian) between the brows, red lips.
wuzetian.dress: Tang court dress: a short jacket over a long skirt tied high under the bust, a long translucent silk shawl (pibo) over the shoulders and trailing on the floor; vermilion and deep red silk with gold-thread borders.

sumyeongjangja.look: Smug old rich man: long loose black hair, a long grey-green beard, half-lidded blank contemptuous eyes, a sour turned-down mouth.
sumyeongjangja.dress: Wide-sleeved white robe with an olive-gold collar band, a gold cord sash with a hanging tassel, a dark red under-sleeve.
sumyeongjangja.demeanor: Rich the way a flood is wet; counts his storehouses the way other men pray.

suro.look: His portrait face: young, warm, a thin moustache and goatee, black hair under a little gold crown.
suro.dress: Purple silk robe with gold-ochre collar bands and sash, as on his portrait.

eras.text: As a ghost in the steam cavern (647) he keeps his portrait's young face, purple silk and little gold crown — never an old white-bearded hermit; barefoot, feet in the water, delighted with himself.

pumsuk.look: Twenty-one, clean-shaven, smooth boyish handsome face, black hair in a topknot under the Hwarang crescent-moon headband; earnest wide eyes that go startled easily.
pumsuk.dress: Ice-blue silk po belted with a brown sash, dark inner sleeves and wrapped forearms (portrait-true).
pumsuk.demeanor: Shy, earnest, overwhelmed: a True Bone boy given a border fortress for his blood. In command he hesitates, looks to older men for the answer, gives an order and takes it back.
pumsuk.carry: Ring-pommel parade sword at the left hip, fox in the gilt ring; never blooded until the last night.
pumsuk.props: THE GOLD BUTTERFLY (only when the scene names it): a thumb-sized hand-hammered Silla gold butterfly pendant, thin gold sheet with tiny punched dots and three trembling gold spangles, one wing visibly a little larger than the other, hung on a short pink silk cord. Gotaso made it herself.

jukji.look: Late twenties, lean sharp Korean face, long loose black hair past the shoulders, heavy-lidded watchful eyes, a small dry mouth that almost never smiles. Unmistakably Korean: BLACK eyes, low bridge, oval face.
jukji.dress: Hwarang years (attached /ch_jukji.png): coral-red silk po over a dark-green inner jeogori and a deep green chima-skirt, dark-green crescent-moon headband with a gold crescent on the brow, small jougwan with two barred pheasant feathers. Arms are for writing, not for a portrait clasp.

hwarang.text: Hwarang (attached /ch_jukji.png): coral-red silk po, dark-green inner and skirt, dark-green crescent-moon headband with a gold crescent, jougwan with two barred feathers, long black hair. Cynical eyes, not a parade smile.

premier.text: Premier (attached /ch_jukji_premier.png): black Tang futou with long wing-flaps, coral-red round-collar yuanlingpao over a white inner collar, a dark patterned sash hanging in two vertical panels down the front; NO jougwan, NO crescent headband. Same long black hair, same sharp eyes. Chinese court dress on a Silla face.

jukji.demeanor: Quiet, exact, a little bitter. Writes standing. Looks at the paper, not the room. Never a clasped-hands fashion plate.
jukji.carry: Ring-pommel bamboo sword at the left hip, rarely drawn.
never: Tang futou while still in hwarang dress
jougwan or a crescent headband once he is Premier

jukjuk.look: Late thirties, weathered Korean face, full dark beard and moustache, tired level eyes, black hair under an iron helm. Heavier than his brother, same family mouth.
jukjuk.dress: Steel lamellar cuirass and skirt over a teal-green coat, beige trousers, a rounded iron helm with cheek-straps tied under the chin (attached /ch_jukjuk.png). Green cloth at collar and sleeve — never yellow, never Baekje yellow, never a yellow metal suit.
jukjuk.demeanor: Patient, unraised voice, a wall given a person. Arms fold because he is waiting, not posing.
never: a court robe or a jougwan on the wall
a yellow sleeve or Baekje yellow cloth

unsang.look: Baekje field general, forties, sun-dark, a short black beard, tired eyes. No portrait: invent a Korean face, never copy another named general.
unsang.dress: Baekje kit: steel lamellar, rounded helm with neck guard, yellow cloth peeking at collar and sash, a red skirt-accent — never a yellow metal cuirass.
unsang.demeanor: A man counting dust. He hesitates with his whole body, then turns the horse.
never: a Silla blue banner on his side

jesang.look: Fifties, long grey-white beard and moustache, silver at the temples, a calm half-lidded Korean face, hair in a high topknot. The south-shore Park who can fill a foreign hall.

child.text: Boyhood (attached /ch_momal_child.png): about eight, SAME FACE BONES as the adult Park (same long oval face, same calm half-lidded eyes, same nose) but a CHILD — BLACK hair in a boy's cut, NO beard, NO moustache, NO silver at the temples, NO topknot. Magenta-plum boy's jeogori over a white inner collar and dark navy inner, white sash, smaller body. Bare head. FACE AND GARMENTS from that child portrait. NEVER the grey-bearded adult.

jesang.dress: Magenta-plum silk po over a white inner collar and a dark navy jeogori (attached /ch_park_jesang.png). Bare head, no jougwan, no crown. Hands that have already decided.
jesang.demeanor: Well-spoken, unhurried, sits when other men kneel. Does not look back at a gate.

eras.text: Boyhood (ch_momal_child): an eight-year-old Park Momal. BLACK hair, no beard, no silver, no topknot. Magenta-plum boy's jeogori, white collar, dark navy inner, white sash. FACE from the child portrait. NEVER the grey-bearded adult body.

never: a grey beard or silver temples on the boy
a blue body halo or neon outline when the fire goes blue — the FIRE is blue, not the man

chisul.look: Fifties, a lined Korean face, tired wanting eyes, long black hair with grey at the temples, worn up with a plain wooden binyeo.
chisul.dress: White silky jeogori, a black sash, a dark full chima (attached /ch_chisul.png). No gold, no crown. A south-shore wife’s dress.
chisul.demeanor: Unfinished. Reaches. Does not forgive the door that closes.
never: a polite smile while they take her

katsuragi.look: Yamato warrior, thirties: square Japanese face, a short dark beard, a fierce scowl, black hair tied high.
katsuragi.dress: Dark steel lamellar under a vermilion-red coat, two swords at the hip, dark wrapped legs (attached /ch_katsuragi.png). Not Korean hanbok. Not a jougwan.
katsuragi.demeanor: Counts distances. Catches the man. Does not enjoy being used.
never: a Silla blue banner on him

shotoku.look: Wa prince: a long oval Japanese face, a neat goatee and moustache, calm half-lidded eyes, hair in a high court topknot.
shotoku.dress: Orange-gold Wa court robe with a dark inner collar, seated or standing in Asuka dress (attached /ch_shotoku.png). Bare-headed — no jougwan, no Korean crown.
shotoku.demeanor: Measured. Does not walk into Jesang’s year.

gwanggaeto.look: Goguryeo great king in his prime: square Korean face, heavy brows, a short dark beard, unhurried eyes that have already counted the room.
gwanggaeto.dress: Out of battle: red Goguryeo court silk, the kingdom crown, white inner collar. In armour (attached /ch_gwanggaeto.png): steel lamellar with red wing shoulder-flaps, a peaked helm or the crown, a red cloak.
gwanggaeto.demeanor: Short orders. Does not get off a horse for a thin king unless he means the boot.

gyeonggeunchogo.look: Baekje’s thirteenth king in his prime: square Korean face, heavy brows, a full dark beard, unhurried slightly cruel eyes.
gyeonggeunchogo.dress: Vermilion-red court po with gold dragon shoulder-plates, white inner collar, dark sash, black silk cap with twin openwork gold flame ornaments (attached /ch_gunchogo.png).
gyeonggeunchogo.demeanor: Warm, rich, a little cruel when he is pleased. Owns the weather.

dodo.look: Young Silla stable-slave: lean Korean face, dark eyes, black hair in a topknot, a mouth that does not smile for the work.
dodo.dress: White inner jeogori, grey sleeveless vest, dark sash, dark hakama-like trousers (attached /ch_dodo.png). No rank silk.
dodo.demeanor: Quiet, asking, not proud. He asks twice. He does the work.

gaero.look: No portrait: invent a Korean Baekje king’s face, never copy Jangsu, Geunchogo or King Sung. Forties, long dark hair going grey at the temples, a thin moustache, frightened measured eyes.
gaero.dress: Baekje king out of battle: ochre-yellow silk po #d9b13a, white inner collar, dark sash, black silk cap with twin openwork gold flame ornaments. In the flight: the cap knocked, yellow silk dirty.
gaero.demeanor: Royal until the gate goes. Then he runs.

jangsu.look: Goguryeo king in his prime: square Korean face, heavy brows, a short dark goatee, grim unhurried eyes. Powerful neck and shoulders.
jangsu.dress: Out of battle: Goguryeo king — red silk court po, the kingdom crown, white inner collar. In armour (attached /ch_jangsu.png): steel lamellar with gold fittings, red wing shoulder-flaps, ornate red-crested helm, a red cloak, a ring-pommel sword at the hip.
jangsu.demeanor: Old power, unhurried. Grants a favour the way a large country grants weather. Stands at a window. Does not chase himself. Sends the horses.

tamhari.look: Young Gaya retainer, a teenager: small fierce Korean face, dark eyes, black hair tied back under a plain white cloth headband. No jougwan.
tamhari.dress: Undyed white po with a pale-blue inner collar, a long red sash hanging down the left hip (attached /ch_tamhari.png). A short knife already in the right hand.
tamhari.demeanor: Short, loyal, not sorry. Does not dress the knife up.
never: a jougwan or a crescent headband

wonsul.look: Yushin's young son: lean Korean face, a bright reckless grin, red liner at the eyes, long black hair. A Gaya fish stamped on the brow-band — his father's pommel, worn as a boy's badge.
wonsul.dress: Periwinkle-lilac po over black sleeves and a white inner collar, magenta sash, small jougwan with two tan pheasant feathers, dark crescent-moon headband with a silver fish (attached /ch_wonsul.png).
wonsul.demeanor: Loud until the gate shuts. Eager in the chase, then lost at his own door.
never: Yushin's adult bulk or marshal face

gwisan.look: Young Hwarang: smooth Korean face, a small confident smirk, red liner at the outer eye, black hair under a cyan crescent-moon headband.
gwisan.dress: Leaf-green po over dark wrapped forearms, brown sash, small jougwan with two tan pheasant feathers (attached /ch_gwisan.png).
gwisan.demeanor: Puts his father on the horse first. Then he stays.
never: leaving the father under the wall

chuhang.look: Young Hwarang: longer wavy brown-black hair, a lazy half-smile, red around the eyes, a hint of stubble. Softer than Gwisan, not less decided.
chuhang.dress: Slate-blue po over dark sleeves, teal crescent-moon headband with a dark swirl, teal sash tails, small jougwan with two tan pheasant feathers (attached /ch_chuhang.png).
chuhang.demeanor: Names the hard precept, then keeps it. Dry in the monk's room.

geomgun.look: Young palace attendant: spare Korean face, a small stubborn mouth, almost no colour on him. Black crescent-moon headband.
geomgun.dress: Charcoal-grey po over black inner sleeves, black sash, small jougwan with two tan pheasant feathers (attached /ch_gumgun.png). The mural remembers him in the yard's clothes.
geomgun.demeanor: One sentence, then the same sentence again. He laughs once. He sits cross-legged. He drinks. He does not fall.

geunrang.look: Young Hwarang, early twenties: a broader, opener Korean face than Geomgun, no beard, dark brows that go up when he is scared for someone. No portrait: invent this face, NEVER copy Yushin, Alchun or Bidam.
geunrang.dress: Silla-blue po, a gold crescent-moon headband, small jougwan. A Hwarang's clothes, not a clerk's.
geunrang.demeanor: Asks three times. Gets loud at the gate. Does not follow him back to the wine.
never: standing in the storehouse at the end

nintoku.look: A seated Wa king: square Japanese face, heavy brows, a short dark goatee and moustache, an appraising scowl, hair in a high topknot. Not Korean dress.
nintoku.dress: White sokutai outer robe with burgundy inner sleeves over a blue patterned hakama, a brown sash, seated on his heels (attached /ch_nintoku.png). Bare-headed — no jougwan, no Korean crown.
nintoku.demeanor: Dry, transactional, a little amused at the catch. Offers a chair. Does not get up.

gotaso.look: Fourteen-fifteen, round young face, bright eyes, black hair up with her gilt butterfly binyeo. A girl, never sexualized.
gotaso.dress: White jeogori with a blue collar, red sash ribbon, pink chima (portrait-true).
gotaso.demeanor: Bold, impatient, loves loudly; asks the same question until it is answered.
gotaso.props: THE GOLD BUTTERFLY (only when the scene names it): a thumb-sized hand-hammered Silla gold butterfly pendant, thin gold sheet with tiny punched dots and three trembling gold spangles, one wing visibly a little larger than the other, hung on a short pink silk cord. Gotaso made it herself.

adult.text: AFTERLIFE ADULT (attached /ch_gotaso.png is FACE BONES only): the same round Korean face grown to a woman of about forty — same eyes, same mouth, same gilt butterfly binyeo, black hair in a full coiled updo. White jeogori with a blue collar, red sash, pink chima, a grown woman's height and shoulders. Tender, not a girl, NEVER sexualized, never a fashion pose.

gumil.look: Thirties, lean border officer, stubble and a thin moustache, orange-red head-wrap with trailing tails, tired angry eyes.
gumil.dress: Rust-red border-officer coat over dark trousers, navy sash, leather bracers, a plain sword at the hip (portrait-true).
gumil.demeanor: Grumbling, humiliated, counting: a yellow-sleeve clerk who knows every sack in the granary.

gumilwife.look: Thirty-one, striking, knowing half-smile, heavy-lidded eyes, dark hair up with a wooden sprig binyeo, loose strands at the neck. The best figure of any woman in the chronicle: tight, curvy hourglass — a tiny waist, full bust and full hips — and she carries it like a weapon; every man in the frame is already looking at her.
gumilwife.dress: Old mended green jeogori washed so thin it clings to her bust and waist, a frayed red sash cinched hard to show how small her waist is, ochre chima pulled snug over her hips (portrait-true). Commoner cloth, no gold — except the gold butterfly once Pumsuk gives it to her.
gumilwife.demeanor: Frank, low-voiced, amused; a master of seduction and teasing — makes a man wait and makes him watch; never learned to look down.
gumilwife.props: THE GOLD BUTTERFLY (only when the scene names it): a thumb-sized hand-hammered Silla gold butterfly pendant, thin gold sheet with tiny punched dots and three trembling gold spangles, one wing visibly a little larger than the other, hung on a short pink silk cord. Gotaso made it herself. THE PEACH (only when the scene names it): a ripe blush peach she sucks slowly instead of biting, juice running to her wrist; she sets it down half-eaten when she has decided.

haewonmek.look: Face hidden under a wide black gat brim, only the mouth and jaw visible; younger and broader than Kangrim.
haewonmek.dress: Black reaper robe over a blue sash and coral-red skirt layers, white gat strings; a long black iron death-blade held low (portrait-true).
haewonmek.demeanor: Dead silent, grave, a little grumpy; asks only for last words.
haewonmek.style: Keep his portrait's ink-brush dissolve at his edges.
never: Haemosu's long white tail of hair once the gat is on

sun.text: Before the night-road: a sun deity like Haemosu (same face bones, same white open po) but SHORT silver-white hair in a tight bun, NO long tail down the back, a golden melted-iron arrow in the chest. Eyes and mouth visible. Never the black gat yet, never the reaper robe until the ink takes him.

heohwangok.look: South Indian princess from Ayuta: deep warm brown skin, clearly darker than every Gaya and Samhan face around her; large dark kohl-lined eyes, full lips, straight nose, blue-black hair coiled low with the purple-tiger binyeo, small gold hoop earrings.
heohwangok.dress: Her portrait silk: violet-purple jeogori with magenta-gold patterned sleeves and cream cuffs, deep violet chima, pale gold sash with tassels. Cut close and tailored: the jacket fitted to the bust and waist, the sash cinched high, the skirt falling clean from the hips; elegant and expensive, never loose, never a sari dump, never pink.
heohwangok.demeanor: Calm, forward, amused; takes the lead; a queen who already knows the answer.
never: pale or East Asian skin tone

ongunhae.look: His portrait face: lean like Chunchu and the same height, only a little broader in the jaw and a few years older, with a short trimmed black beard. Never fat, never round-faced.
ongunhae.demeanor: Quiet, steady, does not need a second instruction.

yongsu.look: Young (as Bihyung, the madman of Surabol): lean, long loose black hair in a careless topknot with ONE stray strand of hair always poking straight up out of it, exactly as on the attached portrait; thin face, quick crooked half-smile.
yongsu.demeanor: When he talks to ghosts or goblins his EYES GO SOLID WHITE (whole eye white, no iris or pupil) — only in those moments, never as a glow or aura. With the living he is distracted, a beat late, half laughing.

eras.text: Young / madman: BLACK hair, the stray strand, cream-and-blue silk from the attached /ch_yongsu.png.

Old Chief Architect at his death and after: SAME FACE BONES as the attached /ch_yongsu.png, WHITE and grey hair in a crooked topknot with ONE stray WHITE strand still poking straight up, ink on the fingers, cream-and-blue silk a little worn. Talking to a crack or a stream: EYES SOLID WHITE. Looking at Munmu or Chunmyung: living black eyes, sideways total fondness.

never: No glowing body, no halo; never neat hair without the stray strand.
a young black-haired Bihyung at his death in 653

sukhuljong.look: Tall, lean royal prince, long black hair (white by old age) in a Silla topknot, narrow cold face, thin beard.
sukhuljong.dress: Fine Silla court silk: white outer po over a deep red inner robe, gold-trimmed collar and sash. Headwear is ONLY the small black Silla jougwan feather cap (or bareheaded with a topknot and gold pin).
never: Never a tall black Chinese official hat: no futou, no winged samo, no tall gauze gwan, no stiff black box hat.

jinheung.look: Young Sacred Bone king: a round boyish face that never quite hardens, dark eyes set a little too wide, a short neat topknot under the open Silla gold crown. As Dharma Cloud: the same face, shaved head, no crown.
jinheung.dress: Deep red Silla court silk, wide sleeves, a gold-trimmed sash. Out of battle he wears the kingdom crown. Late: a plain grey monk's robe, bare feet.
jinheung.demeanor: Practical until he is in love; then he stops looking at maps. At the ditch his mouth is wet and the order still comes out.

sobi.look: Baekje princess: warm oval face, dark eyes that hold a look, a full mouth, black hair in a high coiled bun.
sobi.dress: Baekje court silk in warm yellow #d9b13a, close-fitted jeogori, a long chima, King Muryeong's queen's chain earrings and a gold hairpin. After Gwansan the same silk, no jewelry.
sobi.jewelry: Muryeong queen's gold chain earrings and hairpin out of mourning.
sobi.demeanor: She likes being looked at by one person. She goes still when the room gets political. After the ditch she keeps the lamp where he left it.

seongchung.look: Elderly Baekje councillor: long white hair falling past the shoulders from under a small black silk cap with a single gold openwork flame-and-phoenix ornament pinned at the FRONT of the cap; full white beard and white moustache; heavy-lidded tired eyes, a deep crease between the brows, sun-weathered skin.
seongchung.dress: Deep vermilion-red wide-sleeved court robe over a cream crossed inner collar, a dark indigo-blue sash, two carved jade toggles and a long red tassel hanging at the waist.
