seongchung.demeanor: Tide-tables and unfinished sentences. Anxious, loyal, always asking the question the king will not want; never a young man, never smiling ease.

heungsu.look: Lean Baekje councillor in late middle age: long silver-grey hair in two falling locks from under a tall dark-purple silk official cap with a silver openwork flame-phoenix plaque on the front and two strings of dark-red beads hanging from the brim with gold tassels; thin grey moustache and a pointed grey chin-beard; half-lidded amused eyes, a small knowing smile.
heungsu.dress: Deep wine-red / magenta wide-sleeved robe with a gold-brocade crossed collar and heavy gold-brocade cloud-scroll shoulder panels, a dark sash.
heungsu.demeanor: Dry, already tired of saying it twice. Half-sentences. Smiles when he says the ugly thing.

sara.look: Always young — a Peter Pan boy, late teens at most: oval Korean face, black eyes, a sly closed-mouth smile, black hair in a small topknot under a black cloth headband with loose strands at the temples. Drawn webtoon, never photoreal, never his father’s closed-eye grin.
sara.dress: Sage-green po over a white inner collar, dark teal sash and inner, one sleeve of red wildflowers, a brown strap. Attached /ch_gardener.png.
sara.demeanor: Whimsical, cheeky, unhurried. Jokes at the other gods. Exact about flowers.

wongang.look: Young pregnant Korean woman, oval face, black hair in a low braid over one shoulder, looking back.
wongang.dress: Long vermilion-orange po, black sash, white inner collar, a grey bundle on the hip (attached /ch_wongang.png).
wongang.demeanor: Practical, unsentimental. She already knows how this ends.
never: a smile that is not tired

saradoryeong.look: Hallakgungi’s father Sara: a drawn webtoon adult, not a boy and not a grey photoreal old man. Oval Korean face, eyes closed in a warm grin, long black hair in a tail under a black cloth headband. Attached /ch_sara.png.
saradoryeong.dress: Sage-grey po over a white inner collar, dark navy wrap and sash, red wildflowers in both hands, a woven basket on the hip (attached /ch_sara.png).
saradoryeong.demeanor: Exact, unhurried, finished with the ledger. The father, not an older Hallakgungi.

micheon.look: King Micheon: short black beard and moustache, gold Goguryeo openwork crown with hanging coins, red dragon-brocade robe over black inner, red sash (attached /ch_king_michun.png).
micheon.dress: Red and black court silk, gold dragon shoulders, gold crown.

eras.text: EULBUL the salt seller (attached /ch_ulbul.png): a young dry Korean face, long black braid, straw satgat with a red cloth tail, white hemp po, brown inner, red sash, salt sack on the back, a sly look. No jougwan, no crown, no king-silk.

micheon.demeanor: Quiet, dry, a little funny. Talks like a man still waiting to be told to carry the wood.

suchun.look: King Suchun: stern Korean face, short black beard and moustache, heavy brows, gold Goguryeo openwork crown with hanging coins (attached /ch_suchun.png).
suchun.dress: Deep red court silk with gold dragon shoulders, gold cord belt, black inner (attached /ch_suchun.png).
suchun.demeanor: Quiet until the cup is down. Then one order.

ilu.look: Prince Ilu: long face, thin moustache, black hair in a topknot, white headband (attached /ch_ilu.png).
ilu.dress: Scarlet Goguryeo court po, black sash, white inner cuffs (attached /ch_ilu.png).
ilu.demeanor: Host manners over a plot. Smooth until the screens drop.

sobal.look: Prince Sobal: black eyepatch over the LEFT eye, short beard, black hair in a topknot, white headband (attached /ch_sobal.png).
sobal.dress: Orange-red Goguryeo court po, gold collar embroidery, black sash (attached /ch_sobal.png).
sobal.demeanor: Too loud when he is nervous. The one working eye watches the door.

dalga.look: Dalga: long black hair, short beard, calm soldier’s eyes, tall black official cap (attached /ch_dalga.png).
dalga.dress: Red Goguryeo court robe with grey shoulder boards, dragon-brocade front, black sash, wooden staff (attached /ch_dalga.png).
dalga.demeanor: A popular general who is tired of praise and fond of the boy-king.

bongsang.look: King Bongsang: stern Korean face, short black beard, gold Goguryeo openwork crown with hanging coins (attached /ch_bongsang.png).
bongsang.dress: Deep burgundy-red court silk, gold dragon shoulders, gold cords (attached /ch_bongsang.png).

eras.text: PRINCE SABURU as a youth (face structure from attached /ch_bongsang.png): NO beard, NO crown, a boy of fourteen, black hair in a topknot, red silk po, hiding. Same brow and eye as the portrait, younger.

EXILE / LODGE after the hunt (FACE from attached /ch_bongsang.png): IGNORE the gold crown, IGNORE the clean court silk. Bare head, loose topknot, dirty open red silk, blood on the mouth. The crown is on the floor or gone. Never a crown on this head again.

bongsang.demeanor: Offended, precise, then loose when the wine has sat too long.
never: a crown after the hunt / in the lodge

dolgo.look: Prince Dolgo: long black hair, short neat beard, a warm almost-smiling mouth, tall black official cap (attached /ch_dolgo.png).
dolgo.dress: Red Goguryeo court robe with grey shoulder boards, wooden staff (attached /ch_dolgo.png).
dolgo.demeanor: Warm, already gone in his own head. A father in a hurry.

jaemo.look: Jaemo: square Korean face, sharp eyes, no beard, black hair, a satgat with a long red tail-cord (attached /ch_jaemo.png).
jaemo.dress: White hemp po, rust-red vest, black sash, a white salt rope over the shoulder (attached /ch_jaemo.png).
jaemo.demeanor: Talks too much. Protective. Teases when he is scared.

eummo.look: Ummo: older round Korean face, white hair in a topknot, thin white moustache and goatee (attached /ch_ummo.png).
eummo.dress: Red po with white sleeves, black sash, a dotted hem (attached /ch_ummo.png).
eummo.demeanor: A stall boss. Rest is theft. Talk is theft.

changjori.look: Changjori: lean Korean face, short gray goatee, long IRON-GRAY hair, a small black cap with two thin red antenna-feathers (FACE from attached /ch_changjori.png — IGNORE the portrait’s black hair; the hair is GRAY).
changjori.dress: Red po over white inner, black shoulder boards, no crown (attached /ch_changjori.png).

eras.text: YOUNG CHANGJORI (FACE ONLY from attached /ch_changjori.png): same lean Korean face, short goatee, long BLACK hair, NO grey yet. Junior official — thinner red po over white, small black cap with two thin red antenna-feathers, a ledger, less weight in the shoulders. Keep the goatee. Invent a new pose.

FAMINE-YEARS CHANGJORI: FACE from the sheet but IRON-GRAY long hair and a gray goatee. Same red po, same small black cap with two thin red antenna-feathers. IGNORE the portrait’s black hair. Older, thinner, grain on the shoulders. He looks like a man who has been counting ditches.

changjori.demeanor: Dry, frightened of his own courage. Counts grain out loud. When he begs, the face BREAKS — not a polite smile.
never: black hair after the famine starts

nulji.look: Long loose black hair, heavy scowling brows, a tired king’s mouth. No jougwan.
nulji.dress: Vermilion-red silk po over a darker red inner, white collar, wide black-grey sash (attached /ch_nulji.png). Distinct from his brothers: he is the RED one.
nulji.demeanor: Tight with the court, easy with Jesang. Does not sleep.

bokho.look: Same long-hair Kim-brother face as Nulji, but quieter, older-brother tired.
bokho.dress: Lilac-purple silk po over a white inner, black sash (attached /ch_bokho.png). Distinct: he is the PURPLE one.
bokho.demeanor: Quiet. Knows what a hostage costs.

miseheun.look: Younger Kim-brother face, softer eyes, long loose black hair.
miseheun.dress: Silla-blue silk po over a white inner, dark sash (attached /ch_misahun.png). Distinct: he is the BLUE one.
miseheun.demeanor: Loyal the wrong way — wants to stay with the man who came for him.

mishil.look: Young Park-clan beauty: warm brown eyes, a sly closed-mouth smile, long black hair with a wooden binyeo, gold loop earrings.
mishil.dress: Ivory po wrapped in teal-blue, a blue sash with an orange geometric border (attached /ch_mishil.png).
mishil.demeanor: Dry, amused, a little cruel when a man gets pious.

kingsung.look: Grey-bearded Baekje king, long grey hair, measured eyes.
kingsung.dress: Vermilion court robe, gold dragon shoulder-plates, gold dragon belt, black silk cap with twin openwork gold flame ornaments (attached /ch_sung.png).
kingsung.demeanor: Measured, then suddenly loud when the river is mentioned.

daebyeol.look: Photoreal-numinous elder god: silver-grey hair in a high topknot, grey moustache and short goatee, stern calm Korean face. A longbow on the back. Never a webtoon boy.
daebyeol.dress: Black silk po with ice-blue collar, sash and cuffs, cream inner (attached /ch_big_star.png).
daebyeol.demeanor: Magnanimous, judicial, quiet. Settles a matter in one sentence.

sobyeol.look: Photoreal-numinous god, a shade younger than his brother: silver-grey hair with a wine-red streak, grey stubble, watchful eyes. Never a webtoon boy.
sobyeol.dress: White silk po with maroon-gold brocade bands at collar and cuffs, maroon sash (attached /ch_little_star.png).
sobyeol.demeanor: Quick, a little petty, excuses that almost land as apologies.

samsin.look: Mature white-haired midwife goddess: defined jaw, knowing smile, red lips, gold flower binyeo and a coral-teal spiral pin.
samsin.dress: Blue jeogori, cream inner and cuffs, red chima (attached /ch_samsin.png). Hair ornament from attached /bn_samsin.png.
samsin.demeanor: Warm, frank, laughing. Poses because she likes being looked at.

yumla.look: Grey hair and a full grey beard, a small white animal-skull ornament on the crown, heavy wood-bead necklace, shy eyes.
yumla.dress: Black robe over a high black inner, orange-red lower silk, hands that clasp when he is nervous (attached /ch_yumla.png).
yumla.demeanor: Stern on the bench, stammering around Samsin.

hanbyul.name: Hanbyul
hanbyul.look: Yushin's first horse (no board yet): a plain dark chestnut hwarang mount, nothing grand.
hanbyul.temperament: A creature of habit — carries a sleeping rider where he always goes.

hangyul.name: Hangyul
hangyul.look: Pure white war horse, long flowing white mane, powerful galloping build — match the board.
hangyul.temperament: Eighteen years under Yushin since Nangbi; puts his nose into Yushin's chest and waits.

hanseul.name: Hanseul
hanseul.look: PURE WHITE war horse like Hangyul before him (coat reference: the attached Hangyul board), younger and a hand lighter in the chest; long white mane. At Hwangsanbeol the white horse against Gyebek’s black Gomanari is the picture.
hanseul.temperament: The last horse he names; easy, unafraid, steadier by the Yellow Mountain.

gomanari.name: Gomanari
gomanari.look: Jet-black war horse with a long flowing black mane and tail — match the board. Plain dark tack, a yellow cord at the bridle. The fastest horse in Samhan: at full gallop his body stretches long and low, neck level, ears pinned, mane and tail streaming flat behind, hooves barely touching.
gomanari.temperament: Named for Gomanaru (Ungjin); stands by its master's planted sword after the field.

bisamun.name: Bisamun
bisamun.look: Dark mahogany blood-bay, heavy thick black mane and long forelock, black legs — match the board. Plain dark tack with a short string of prayer beads tied at the bridle.
bisamun.temperament: Named for Vaiśravaṇa, guardian of the north; will not be led by anyone else.

hadong.name: Hadong
hadong.look: Lean rangy red bay, lighter than Bisamun, fine head, black stockings and thinner black mane — match the board. Court tack with magenta tassels.
hadong.temperament: A diplomat's horse: patient on long roads, waits outside gates.

chunma.name: Chunma
chunma.look: WINGLESS white heavenly horse in the Cheonmachong saddle-flap style: long arched neck, streaming white mane and tail, legs flung out in a flying gallop. It has NO WINGS — no feathers, no bird wings, nothing growing from the shoulders. It rides the sky on curling cloud-and-flame streamers trailing from its legs and chest, as on the painted birch-bark flap. Divine render: numinous through scale and atmosphere, never a glow outline.
chunma.temperament: Kneels and cries beside the purple egg at Najeong, sees men approach, neighs and rises into the sky.

sinrok.name: Sinrok
sinrok.look: Pale white-gold stag with tall branching antlers — match the board's animal, but ignore its glow outline: light catches the antlers and coat as real light.
sinrok.temperament: Owned by no one; leads the brothers south and stays with Onjo.

samjogo.name: Samjogo
samjogo.look: Black three-legged crow — always THREE legs visible; red sun motif as the one accent — match the board.
samjogo.temperament: Owned by no one; watches from branches and far banks, flies ahead to show Jumong the way.

huanglong.name: Huanglong
huanglong.kind: yellow dragon, guardian of the Tang throne
huanglong.look: TANG-DYNASTY dragon painted in gold ink-brush: lean long-necked serpentine body in an S-curve, four lean leonine legs striding, THREE claws on each foot, long open-jawed snout with fangs, two backswept horns, whiskers and mane flung out as dry calligraphic gold brush strokes, whip tail ending in a flame tuft; burnished gold-yellow scales with ochre-umber shading — match the board, not a later Ming/Qing five-claw dragon, never a realistic scaled 3D dragon. Divine render: numinous through scale and atmosphere, coiling through black ink cloud and lamp smoke; light catches the scales as real light, never a glow outline. Its stills are predominantly dark and intimidating Chinese ink painting: splashed black ink, smoke, the gold dragon the main colour in the dark; every figure is ink-painted except the Second Emperor, who stays a full-colour webtoon figure.
huanglong.temperament: Owned by no one but sits behind whoever holds the dais; it coils over Chang'an and turns its head only for the Son of Heaven.

gonyeon.name: Gonyeon
gonyeon.look: Stocky, powerful northern steppe horse — deep-bodied and shorter-legged than a war horse, thick crested neck, round barrel, heavy quarters, broad forehead, large kind dark eyes; coat an even deep CHOCOLATE BROWN (not red bay, not black) with a lighter mealy tan muzzle; THICK SHAGGY dark-brown mane falling both sides, long full tail nearly to the ground; plain old leather halter with one small gold frog charm at the brow band — match the board.
gonyeon.temperament: Old, patient and wise. Stopped at the pond of Gonyeon and wept at a boulder until King Haeburu had it turned over, and the gold-frog child Geumwa was underneath; it has walked beside him ever since.

gom.name: Gom
gom.kind: great bear, guardian of Old Joseon
gom.look: HUGE dark-brown bear, far bigger than a man — massive shoulder hump, thick shaggy dark chocolate-brown fur with lighter tips catching the light, broad heavy head, small dark eyes, short round ears, long curved claws — match the board. Divine render: numinous through scale and atmosphere, never a glow outline.
gom.temperament: Ungnyeo's first shape: the bear that kept to the cave for a hundred days on mugwort and garlic and came out a woman. In the shape she left behind it stays near her son: patient, enormous, gentle with him and with no one else.

gwahama.name: Gwahama
gwahama.look: SMALL sturdy WHITE Jeju pony, barely chest-high to a man — short strong legs, round barrel, thick neck, short head, big dark eyes, full thick white mane and tail; plain rope halter, no saddle — match the board. The horse small enough to ride under the fruit trees: an orange branch can clear its ears.
gwahama.temperament: Cheeky and unbothered. Steals oranges from the basket, follows Yuri Dora around the island like a dog, and refuses to hurry for anyone.

kinshi.name: Kinshi
kinshi.look: Large GOLDEN KITE (bird of prey): long angled wings with fingered primaries, forked tail, hooked beak, fierce yellow eye; feathers burnished gold with umber barring — match the board. A real bird lit by real light, never a glow outline.
kinshi.temperament: The kite of the Jimmu legend that landed on the first emperor's bow and blinded his enemies with its flash. It rides the wind ahead of Yamato's ships and lands only on a drawn bow.

damul.name: Damul
damul.look: The biggest horse on any field: a red-bay Goguryeo war stallion, coat a deep BROWN-RED like oxblood lacquer (browner and darker than Hadong, redder and larger than Bisamun), a thick BLACK mane and BLACK tail, black lower legs, heavy arched neck — match the board. In battle it wears Goguryeo 개마 (gaema) barding as in the Anak Tomb No. 3 mural: steel lamellar skirts over the body and neck, a steel chamfron on the face, red cords and a red plume; the black mane falls over the steel.
damul.temperament: Named for 다물 (多勿), the old Goguryeo word for winning back the lost land; charges into water and spears without being asked, bites other horses.

sunfox.name: Sun-Fox
sunfox.look: Large pale cream-white fox with long flowing fur and a full brush tail — match the board's animal, but ignore its orange glow outline: #f0b429 lives as real low sunlight on the fur, never a halo.
sunfox.temperament: The heat that walks when the chariot cannot; leads Yuhwa down the exile road to Buyeo, looks back once, never explains the map.

baitiwu.name: Baitiwu
baitiwu.kind: war horse, first of the Six Steeds of Zhaoling
baitiwu.look: Jet-black Tang war horse, black from ear to tail, with four pure WHITE hooves and white pasterns as though it walked through snow. Tang royal grooming: mane clipped into three upright tufts (三花), tail bound up in a knot; red-tasselled Tang tack.
baitiwu.temperament: Runs all night without being asked twice; two hundred li after a battle, to the enemy's gate by dawn.

telebiao.name: Telebiao
telebiao.kind: war horse, one of the Six Steeds of Zhaoling
telebiao.look: Pale yellow-gold Tang war horse with a WHITE muzzle, a steppe horse with a Turkic name; compact, deep-chested. Tang royal grooming: mane clipped into three upright tufts (三花), tail bound up in a knot.
telebiao.temperament: Never complains: eight engagements in a day, two days without food, three without the rider's armour off.

saluzi.name: Saluzi
saluzi.kind: war horse, the first and dearest of the Six Steeds of Zhaoling
saluzi.look: Purple-roan Tang war horse — a deep plum-chestnut coat with a violet bloom, the colour of a fresh bruise; proud high head, arched neck. Tang royal grooming: mane clipped into three upright tufts (三花), tail bound up in a knot; in battle a red saddle-cloth and red tassels.
saluzi.temperament: Out in front of everyone, always. Takes an arrow in the chest outside Luoyang and stands with it in him until the rider is safe; carries him back to camp, then dies.

qingzhui.name: Qingzhui
qingzhui.kind: war horse, one of the Six Steeds of Zhaoling
qingzhui.look: Blue-grey DAPPLED Tang war horse, pale grey with darker round dapples, the fastest of the six; long legs fully extended in the flying gallop. Tang royal grooming: mane clipped into three upright tufts (三花), tail bound up in a knot.
qingzhui.temperament: Fast as a rumour: at Hulao five arrows strike him, every one from behind.

shifachi.name: Shifachi
shifachi.kind: war horse, one of the Six Steeds of Zhaoling
shifachi.look: Pure blazing RED chestnut Tang war horse, red as cinnabar seal paste, wearing a Turkic title as its name. Tang royal grooming: mane clipped into three upright tufts (三花), tail bound up in a knot.
shifachi.temperament: Finishes the charge with five arrows in the hindquarters, bristling like a hedgehog that has lost its temper.

quanmaogua.name: Quanmaogua
quanmaogua.kind: war horse, last of the Six Steeds of Zhaoling
quanmaogua.look: Tawny-yellow Tang war horse with a CURLY, crimped coat and a BLACK muzzle — the ugliest horse in the empire; thick-necked, stubborn stance. Tang royal grooming: mane clipped into three upright tufts (三花), tail bound up in a knot.
quanmaogua.temperament: Nine arrows by the Ming River, six in front and three behind; stands until the fighting is done, then lies down.

hwangsan.dna: Low rolling yellow-dust plain under a vast sky, Baekje stockade on a rise; few trees; dust is the weather.

daeya.dna: Daeya seongmun: weathered stone wall with crenellations, curved giwa pavilion over a hongye arch, heavy iron-bossed timber doors.

ansi.dna: Ansi: stone fortress on a ridge, the Tang earthen siege mound rising against the wall.

jolbon.dna: Jumong Cavern (국동대혈): the same wide stone cave mouth in a green hillside every still — tree trunks standing in the opening, leaf-light, packed-earth floor, dark stone overhead, a bright green forest and a far ridge through the mouth. Not a palace, not a tomb.

salsu.dna: The Colossal River (Salsu / Cheongcheon): a broad shallow gravel-bar river between low pine hills in northern Goguryeo, pale water in summer, a wide ford, timber stakes at a hidden throat, no fortress, no ships.

surabol.dna: Seorabeol palace: Silla giwa halls, packed-earth yards, timber verandas.

sabi.dna: Sabi palace on the Baengma river bluffs; Baekje giwa halls and pavilions.

pyongyang.dna: Pyongyang: Goguryeo walled city on the Taedong, stone walls and red munru gate pavilions.

gungnae.dna: Gungnae palace: Goguryeo timber halls, red pillars, painted beams, packed-earth yards, giwa roofs inside a stone fortress on the Yalu bend. Night banquet: one lamp-row, black floor, screens.

asuka.dna: Asuka: Wa’s early court — timber palaces on packed earth, raised floors, tiled and thatched roofs, a wide gravel yard, cypress and cryptomeria, not a Korean giwa capital.

moon_palace.dna: Moon Palace (월성): Silla night court — timber halls, giwa roofs, packed-earth yards under moonlight, red pillars, a dark inner room with one lamp.

tsushima.dna: Mountain Island (대마도): a steep green volcanic island in the strait, black rock lee, a hidden cove, pine on the ridge, grey water, Wa ships on one side and a smaller Silla hull tucked in the shadow of the cliff. Wood Island (목도): a bare black-rock outcrop off that shore, no hall, a piled wood pyre, pine on the far ridge, grey water.

steam_cavern.dna: Golhwacheon (골화천), the steam cavern hot spring: a dark pond under wet black stone, steam, motes in the element colors; everyone bathes IN the black water like a Korean public bath, bare bathing bodies, nothing on but water; generally dark, magical anime-painterly atmosphere, not a photoreal cave.

wirye.dna: Wirye: earthen walls on the Han river plain below the mountains.

gwansan.dna: Gwansan: a winter mountain fortress in the hills — weathered stone ridge, a packed-earth road that was not there at dusk, a frozen ditch, timber posts, no palace.

cheomseongdae.dna: Cheomseongdae: the bottle-shaped stone star tower on a grass field under the night sky.

underworld.dna: Otherworld — symbolic flat color, no naturalistic weather.

radiance.dna: Myeonghwal (Radiance) Fortress: Bidam's mountain wall facing Wolseong across the field.

pyongyang_fortress.dna: Pyongyang fortress: the same red two-tier munru on the stone ridge in every still.

changan.dna: Tang palace of Chang'an, drawn from the Daming Palace (大明宮) site and reconstruction models: Hanyuan Hall's concave ensemble — an eleven-bay hall with a double-eaved hipped roof of dark grey tiles and curled owl-tail ridge ends (chiwei), red columns, white plaster walls, lattice windows, raised on three tiers of rammed-earth terraces faced in ochre-red plaster and edged with white stone balustrades; the Dragon Tail Way ramps folding up the terraces; forward on each side the Xiangluan and Qifeng que-towers (three stepped pavilions on tall battered grey-brick piers) joined to the hall by long roofed corridors; a vast paved square below, entered through the five-doored Danfeng Gate. Wide low Tang proportions, deep eaves on massive bracket sets. Tang palette is VERMILION and WHITE (red columns, white walls); roofs are black-grey tile trimmed with green-glazed ridge and eave tiles (a little yellow and blue tricolour glaze); balustrade posts painted red, blue and green. YELLOW belongs to the emperor's robe; gold is gilt-bronze fittings, lamp-trees and firelight on vermilion. Interiors: dark polished stone floors, rows of vermilion columns, gauze hangings, a raised dais with a painted screen behind the throne. Never the Forbidden City, never all-yellow glazed roofs, never the modern reconstruction or a city skyline.
changan.mood: TANG RENDER: predominantly DARK and INTIMIDATING Chinese ink painting (shuimohua) — black and grey ink washes, wet-on-wet ink bleeding into rice paper, dry calligraphic brush for roofs, columns, smoke and robes, the vermilion and gold reduced to small accents in a world of ink; officials, guards and other Tang figures are ink figures too. The ONE exception is the Second Emperor himself: he keeps the house webtoon figure render in full colour (yellow robe, black futou, drawn face), a coloured man inside an ink empire. Staged like a Chinese historical drama (Legend of the Demon Cat, The Longest Day in Chang'an) but lit as full Heewon tenebrism: night or blue hour; ONE dominant hard key per shot — a backlight through open doors or lattice, or one lamp-tree — and 75% of the frame crushed black with no fill; colour contrast — gold-yellow flame highlights against cool blue-green in the few lit shadows; the other flames (lamp-trees, silk lanterns with no writing, braziers) are small points and round bokeh IN the black, never lighting the room evenly; red lantern light through lattice as one pattern on the floor; incense haze only inside the key shaft; polished dark floors reflecting the flames. Staged like a drama, at true human scale: camera at eye or knee height on a dolly or crane; court officials in two lines facing inward along the central aisle with tablets; banquet tables in two long facing rows with dancers in the centre and the emperor on the dais at the head; exteriors are real-scale terraces and corridors, the hall large but never a fantasy fortress.

amnok.dna: Amnok river: wide green water, reeds and stony banks, natural sky.

jumong_cave.dna: The cavern where Jumong prays after the crossing.

wolji.dna: Wolji (월지): a still palace pond by Wolseong, timber colonnade on stone footings, giwa reflected in black water, lotus, one lantern path; not a modern park reconstruction.

jade_gate_valley.dna: Jade Gate Valley (옥문곡): two long pine ridges almost meeting in a rock throat three men wide, a fog-bowl with a spring that never freezes, a steep white back wall under a hill fort, a dry creek, one great rock beside the spring. Keep this exact fold of ridges and the throat in every still.

amak.dna: Amak Fortress (아막성, Unbong saddle): a stone ring on a high pass between two pine hills, a hongye gate with a small giwa munru, packed-earth road east toward Silla and a wide high field west toward Namwon; below the west lip a black pine-pond (Cheonsan). Keep this exact saddle and the pond in every still.

hwarang_yard.dna: Hwarang yard as the Silla mansion compound: red timber gate in a stone-and-plaster wall, packed-earth court, grey giwa roofs receding in mist, a painted precepts wall under its own roof, Moon Palace roofs tiny beyond. Keep this exact gate and court in every yard still.

hwarang_gate.dna: Hwarang yard gate: heavy timber leaves with iron bosses, a giwa-roofed gatehouse, packed-earth road leading in, the painted wall starting just inside.

ghost_bridge.dna: 귀교: a low bridge of dressed granite slabs over a dark ditch (Hwangcheon), west of Wolseong; no rail to speak of; pines and a temple roof dissolving; stones that look laid in one night.

sasu.dna: Snake River (사수): a winter willow bend, a frozen plane of river-ice, one serpent curve of the channel, willows on the near bank, Goguryeo low hills dissolving; empty of armies, no light-pillar, no people.

mannogun.dna: Manno: a low wooden palisade, one granary, a leaking timber county office, hills that have changed hands.

eastern_harbor.dna: Silla eastern harbour: grass giving over to sand, a short timber quay, boats pulled up, the East Sea flat and silver, no cliff city.

jolbon_well.dna: Jolbon well-yard: packed earth, a stone well rim, timber well-house, nobody stands in the shaft.

gibeolpo.dna: Final Ford (기벌포): the Geum river mouth, a wide tidal ford, mudflats, a timber landing, the sea opening west.

realms_pavilion.dna: The yearly 정자: a small octagonal Korean pavilion with RED timber posts and rail, a teal-green giwa roof, sitting on a spit of earth in THREE-COLOR water — vermilion on one side (이승), deep blue on another (저승), sage-green on the third (서천꽃밭). Keep this exact pavilion. Otherworld: symbolic sky (flat cream or crushed black), no sun, no moon, no weather dump, never the modern city skyline on the board.

harmony_council.dna: Silla Harmony Council chamber (화백당): six empty seats around ONE round black-lacquer table, a small brazier or oil lamp at the centre, timber posts, paper lattice, grey giwa dark above; empty of people. Early years may be a leaking tent — this board is the settled timber hall.

chunchu_study.dna: Chunchu's private study: one writing desk, ledgers, a half-shuttered paper lattice, crushed black; magenta #D8258C as the one lamp bounce on silk and paper, never a glow. Empty of people. Not the Revenue Office clerk hall.

revenue.dna: Revenue Office (품주) / later Royal Secretariat hall (집사부 청사): one timber hall, a long clerk-bar of desks in two facing rows, a raised premier seat at the head, paper screens, one aisle. Empty of people. Early: messy rice ledgers. After 651: the same hall, cleaner, fourteen ministry plaques. Same architecture both eras.

ministers_assembly.dna: Baekje Ministers' Assembly hall at Sabi: king dais at the helm, a centre aisle, four-and-four inner benches (좌평) and four-and-four outer (달솔), the sweating Rock of Politics (정사암) at the foot of the aisle; yellow #d9b13a cloth as the one accent. Empty of people. Not Deer Rock outdoors.

high_summit.dna: Goguryeo High Summit chamber: a pentagon table inlaid with the three-legged crow, five empty sword-stands behind the seats, crimson sun-crow banners, red pillars, a far door on the axis. Empty of people. Not the banquet hall of the massacre.

pyongyang_hall.dna: Pyongyang royal banquet hall: red timber pillars, a long empty court, iron-bossed timber doors that open on the yard, polished dark floor. Empty of people. Keep this exact doorway and pillar rhythm in every massacre still. Not the High Summit pentagon table.

locked_room.dna: Suulbu's house-apart: a small timber annex, iron-barred door, one paper lattice, a drain-gap at the back wall; night, one lamp. Empty of people.

manmyung_room.dna: Manmyung's one room at Manno: timber floor, a door that shuts, one lamp, granary light through paper; not the county office.

ships.common: SHIPS: copy the attached ship board for each kingdom exactly (hull shape, mast count, sail colour and battens) and keep that same ship in every still of the scene. Boards are design only: ignore their bright daylight sky and calm sea, repaint the ship in the scene light. 7th-century timber ships only, never European hulls, cannon or funnels. TRUE SCALE (real 7th-century measures; a man is 1.65 m): ships are drawn life-size against their crews and against each other, never toy boats with giant men. A man standing on deck is about 1/15 the length of a 24 m warship and 1/20 of a 35 m tower-ship; a deck bulwark reaches his chest; the waterline is two men's height below a warship deck. Dozens of men fit along one side of a warship, each one small against the hull, masts four or five men tall. When two kingdoms' ships share a frame, keep their real length ratio.

goguryeo.text: Goguryeo warship: long high-sided timber hull with an oar-port gallery along the side, raised stern castle, three masts with cream battened sails, red Goguryeo banners at the stern. Size: about 25 m long and 6 m wide, deck about 2.5 m above the water, stern castle two storeys, about sixty men aboard; a little shorter and lower than a Tang tower-ship, about the size of a Tang ordinary warship.

silla.text: Silla ship: plain broad timber hull with a low deck cabin, two masts with cream battened square sails, small blue Silla pennant. Smaller and lighter than the Goguryeo and Tang warships. Size: about 20 m long and 5 m wide, forty to fifty men.

baekje.text: Baekje ship: elegant golden-timber hull with an upswept prow, one large cream battened sail and yellow pennant-sails, yellow Baekje banners. Size: about 18 m long and 4 m wide, about thirty men.

tang.text: Tang louchuan tower-ship: huge dark timber hull with a multi-storey deck castle, two or three masts of deep red battened sails, the largest ship on any sea. Size: the flagship tower-ship is about 35 m long and 8–9 m wide, deck about 3 m above the water, its three-storey castle rising about 12 m (seven men tall), up to two hundred men aboard; the ordinary Tang warship is about 24 m long with forty to ninety men, its deck a man's height higher than any Yamato or Baekje boat. Its broadside looks like a city wall.

yamato.text: Yamato ship: long low white-and-red hull, two masts with pale yellow battened sails, open oared deck. Size: about 15 m long and 3 m wide, gunwale only knee-to-waist high above the water, ten to thirty men rowing standing up; a Tang hull towers over it like a wall.

tamla.text: Tamla boat: small single-mast golden-timber island boat with one cream lug sail. Size: about 10 m long, a dozen men.

ayuta.text: Heo Hwangok's Ayuta ship: ornate red-and-gold lacquered hull with painted panels, one great crimson battened sail and a small red mizzen; the only red sail on the southern sea.
